title: Marketing VA — Rental Listings & Marketplace (Miami Real Estate)
description:
About the Role



We are a Miami-based luxury rental team and we need someone reliable to own our listing presence every single day. This is a focused, repeatable role — not a full-time job, not client-facing, and not complicated. But it has to get done every day without being chased.



You will spend roughly 90 minutes each morning making sure our listings are live, accurate, and current. You will remove anything expired or unavailable, post new properties, keep a simple tracker up to date, and stage drafts for
 Marketplace so they are ready to go.



That is the whole job. We want someone who is organized, consistent, and takes ownership of their piece of the operation without needing to be reminded.



What You'll Do



Audit live rental listings daily — flag anything expired, unavailable, or with bad info

Remove dead listings from active channels

Post new listings as they come in, following our templates and format guidelines

Keep a simple daily tracker current (listing name, status, date posted, channel)

Stage
 Marketplace drafts and submit them for review

Send a short daily report: X live, X removed, X posted, X staged



What We're Looking For



Reliable above everything else. You show up every day and get it done.

Comfortable with
 Marketplace posting

Organized — you maintain a tracker without being told

You follow a checklist without needing to reinvent the process

Clean English writing — listings need to look professional (we built a GPT to help with this part)

No luxury real estate experience required, but you must follow our standards exactly



This role does NOT involve:



Client communication of any kind

Phone calls

Lead generation or sales



To Apply



Send a short message answering this: how do you currently organize your daily tasks? What do you use to make sure nothing falls through the cracks? Keep it practical — no long cover letters.

title: Content Writer & Community Manager – Reddit, Quora, Medium & LinkedIn
description:
ABOUT US



Istanbul Airport AssistME is an airport concierge and ground assistance provider serving passengers travelling through Istanbul Airport (IST).



Our team has been providing passenger assistance services since 2018, including Meet & Assist, Fast Track, porter, lounge, buggy and airport transfer coordination.



We are looking for a reliable and intelligent English Content Writer & Community Manager for a long-term position.



This is not a simple copy-and-paste posting job. You will be responsible for researching, writing, publishing and managing original content across four platforms:



• Reddit

• Quora

• Medium

• LinkedIn



ROLE DETAILS



• Part-time: approximately 20 hours per week

• Remote position

• Flexible working hours

• Long-term opportunity

• Possibility of increased hours based on performance



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



Reddit



• Find relevant discussions about Istanbul Airport, airport greeting services,  transfers, flight connections, baggage, Fast Track and passenger assistance

• Write useful and ***natural comments*** that genuinely answer the passenger’s question

• Create informative Reddit posts without sounding promotional

• Respond to comments and follow-up questions

• Follow the rules of each subreddit

• Clearly disclose your relationship with our company whenever our services are mentioned

• Never pretend to be a customer or publish fake recommendations



Quora



• Find relevant airport and travel questions

• Research and write clear, accurate and helpful answers

• Manage the company’s Quora Business Profile

• Respond to comments and additional questions

• Include our company or website only when it is genuinely relevant



Medium



• Research and write two original airport-related articles per week

• Create useful passenger guides about Istanbul Airport, transfers, baggage, Meet & Assist, Fast Track, families, elderly passengers and complicated connections

• Format and publish the articles on Medium

• Add headings, images, sources and relevant website links

• Update previously published articles when airport information changes



LinkedIn



• Open & Manage the company’s LinkedIn page

• Write and publish three professional posts per week

• Create content about airport services, passenger experience, company updates and B2B partnerships

• Respond to relevant comments and messages

• Keep the company profile complete and up to date



CONTENT RESEARCH



You will create the content yourself. We will not provide finished articles or posts.



You must:



• Research each subject before writing

• Prioritize official airport, airline, government and other trustworthy sources

• Check facts carefully before publishing

• Ask us before publishing any uncertain operational information

• Never invent terminal information, service availability, prices, meeting points or airport procedures

• Write every piece of content in natural, fluent English

• Adapt the content separately for each platform instead of copying the same text everywhere

• Maintain a weekly content calendar

• Keep a record of all published links



EXPECTED WEEKLY OUTPUT



• Reddit: 7–8 original posts and regular helpful comments

• Quora: 5–7 detailed answers

• Medium: 3-4 original articles

• LinkedIn: 5 professional posts

• Daily monitoring of comments and replies

• Weekly report containing published links, basic performance figures and next week’s content plan



IMPORTANT CONTENT RULES



We do not allow:



• Fake customer reviews or recommendations

• Pretending to be an independent customer

• Spam comments or mass link posting

• Copying content from other websites

• Publishing the same content across every platform

• Generic, unedited AI-generated content

• Invented airport information

• Buying followers, votes, comments or backlinks

• Creating additional accounts without permission



AI tools may be used to assist with research and drafting, but every piece must be fact-checked, rewritten and reviewed by you before publication.



REQUIREMENTS



• Excellent written English

• Strong online research and fact-checking skills

• Experience writing articles, answers or social media content

• Familiarity with Reddit culture and community rules

• Ability to write helpful content without making it sound like an advertisement

• Good judgment and attention to detail

• Ability to work independently and meet weekly deadlines

• Experience with Quora, Medium or LinkedIn is an advantage

• Travel, aviation or hospitality experience is an advantage



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with the word “ISTANBUL” so we know you read the complete job description...



Include:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your relevant writing or community-management experience

3. Links to two or three English writing samples

4. Which of the four platforms you have previously managed

5. Your expected monthly salary for 20 hours per week

6. Your internet speed and usual working hours

7. A short answer of no more than 20 words to this sample passenger question:



“Do I need to collect and re-check my baggage if I have separate flight tickets at Istanbul Airport?”



We are looking for someone who writes clearly, checks facts carefully and understands the difference between genuinely helping travellers and promoting a company.

title: Static Ad Creative Producer — E-commerce / Meta Ads (AI image tools)
description:
Static Ad Creative Producer — E-commerce / Meta Ads (AI image tools)



JOB TYPE

Full-time (40 hrs/week) · Long-term · Work from home



SALARY

$400 – $700 USD/month depending on experience, paid monthly. Paid trial project first (see "How to apply"). Raise after 90 days based on results, plus a bonus every time one of your creatives becomes a winner we scale.



THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE

I run several e-commerce brands (supplements and DTC products) and I currently produce all the static ads for Meta myself. I have a documented, proven system for it — I need one person to take it over completely and run it every day.



This is NOT a "design something pretty" job. It is a production job with a system: research what already works, rebuild it for our product, ship volume, keep everything organized so we can tell exactly which creative made money.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY

Research winning ads. Go through ad libraries and spy tools, find the static ads that big brands are running the longest (long-running = profitable). Save them into our swipe library.

Rebuild them for our products. When we clone a winning ad, the image is copied faithfully — same composition, same framing, same energy. Only the text, the product and the proof numbers change. "Close enough" is not close enough here.

Produce new creatives from our blueprint system. We work with detailed image prompts (AI generation: Nano Banana / similar tools). You generate, you check, you regenerate until it is right.

Always 1080×1080. Every single static, no exception, even when the reference ad is vertical — you recompose the layout inside the square. You verify the exported dimensions before delivery.

Write the on-image copy following our rules: name the exact customer and her/his problem so the person recognizes themselves in one second; benefit + the reason it works, never a vague slogan; a banned-words list to respect so the ad account never gets flagged.

Tag every creative with 5 labels: Concept (the visual format) × Angle × Sub-avatar × Hook × Awareness level. This is how we know which combination wins, so it must never be skipped.

Keep the asset registry. Every image gets a unique name, gets archived, and gets logged with the prompt that produced it. We must be able to find and relaunch any winner months later without regenerating it.

Deliver a review page at the end of each batch: every visual displayed large, with its tags, ready for me to approve in a few minutes.

VOLUME WE EXPECT

30 to 60 finished statics per week once you are trained (first weeks will be slower — that is normal and expected).



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE

Solid written English. You will be writing headlines that must sound native and punchy. This is the #1 filter.

Real experience with Photoshop or Canva or Figma — you can rebuild a layout, match a font, place text cleanly, export exact dimensions.

You have used AI image generation tools (Midjourney, Nano Banana, Firefly, Stable Diffusion or similar) and you know that the first output is rarely the good one.

Extremely organized. File naming, folders, spreadsheets/registries — this part of the job is as important as the design part.

You follow a written process exactly. When the process says "always 1080×1080" or "never use this word", there is no interpretation.

Reliable daily communication, and you tell me when something is blocked instead of going silent.

NICE TO HAVE (not required)

You have worked on Meta /
 ads before and know what gets an account restricted.

You understand direct response marketing (hooks, angles, awareness levels) — or you are hungry to learn it. I will train you on our system.

Basic video editing.

IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

Some of the brands are in the health and women's wellness space, including intimacy/sexual wellness products. The work is never explicit, but if that topic is not something you are comfortable working on every day, this role is not for you and that is completely fine.



WHY THIS JOB IS GOOD

The system already exists and is proven — you are not inventing anything from zero, you are running a machine.

Direct work with the owner, no middle manager, fast decisions.

Clear success metric: creatives that make sales. When you produce winners, you earn more.

Long-term position. I am looking for someone to keep for years, not for one project.

HOW TO APPLY

Applications that ignore these steps are deleted without reading — please follow them exactly.



Start your message with the word SQUARE so I know you read the whole post.

Send a portfolio or 3–5 examples of ads, banners or graphics you have made. Say clearly which parts you did yourself.

Answer in 2–3 sentences: when you copy an existing winning ad for a different product, what exactly should change and what must stay the same?

Tell me which AI image tools you have used, and roughly how many images you have generated.

Tell me your monthly rate and how many hours per week you can commit.

Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial task (I will send you one reference ad to rebuild for one of our products, in 1080×1080, with 3 headline variations). Good trials get hired within a few days.

title: HR Operations & Compliance Coordinator
description:
Attach your resume when applying. 



Position Summary



The HR Operations & Compliance Coordinator is a key member of the Human Resources team responsible for supporting a broad range of HR functions across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, benefits administration, policy administration, compliance, and day-to-day HR operations. This is a true HR generalist role suited for a dynamic professional who can balance operational execution with thoughtful employee support.

The Company’s HR function operates within its broader Legal and Compliance structure under the oversight of the General Counsel. In this role, the Coordinator will work closely with the HR Manager, General Counsel, legal team, and other internal stakeholders to help ensure HR processes are efficient, consistent, and compliant.



Although broad in scope, this role places particular emphasis on employee relations, leave management, and compliance. The ideal candidate will be skilled at navigating sensitive workplace matters, supporting investigations and conflict resolution, managing leave and accommodation processes, and exercising sound judgment when handling confidential and complex employee issues.



Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Employee Relations Support

? Assist with employee relations investigations and fact-finding conversations under the direction of the HR Manager.

? Take detailed and objective notes during employee meetings and investigations.

? Prepare written summaries and employee statements in a neutral and factual manner.

? Conduct timely follow-up with employees, managers, and other stakeholders as directed.

? Organize and maintain investigation files and legal documentation.

? Track employee relations matters and maintain case management records.

Leave of Absence Administration

? Assist with administration of leave requests, including medical leave, maternity leave, and other protected leaves.

? Respond to leave-related inquiries and provide appropriate notices and paperwork based on the employee's situation.

? Track completion and return of required documentation.

? Maintain accurate leave records and monitor deadlines.

? Coordinate with onshore and offshore support teams to ensure timely processing.

ADA Accommodation Process

? Support the interactive accommodation process under the supervision of the HR Manager.

? Review accommodation requests and supporting medical documentation.

? Validate receipt and completeness of physician certifications and related documentation.

? Track accommodation requests and maintain required records.

? Coordinate communications with employees, managers, and third-party providers as needed.

Compliance & Training Administration

? Maintain compliance training records and generate weekly training reports.

? Verify employee compensation for required training has been processed appropriately.

? Follow up with managers regarding overdue training requirements.

? Coordinate annual labor law poster compliance and distribution.

? Assist with implementation and tracking of compliance initiatives.

HR Operations & Administration

? Issue company communications related to payroll schedules, holidays, office closures, and other operational updates.

? Assist with onboarding and administration of independent contractors and 1099 engagements.

? Coordinate ad hoc background screening requests for healthcare professionals and other specialized positions.

? Assist with annual performance review administration and tracking.

Employment Eligibility & Compliance

? Maintain working knowledge of Form I-9 requirements and employment eligibility verification procedures.

? Provide guidance and training support to offshore team members regarding I-9 processing.

? Assist with E-Verify administration and maintenance.

? Support audits and compliance reviews related to employment eligibility documentation.

Benefits Administration

? Assist with benefits administration activities, including government contract-related benefit requirements.

? Support annual Open Enrollment activities.

? Assist with 401(k) enrollment and administrative processes.

? Maintain PTO administration systems and employee records.

Policy & Process Support

? Under the guidance of the HR Manager, assist with interpreting company policies and applicable employment laws.

? Provide administrative support for policy implementation and compliance initiatives.

? Identify opportunities for process improvements and recommend efficiencies to enhance HR operations.

Qualifications

? 3+ years of progressive experience in Human Resources, Employee Relations, Leave Administration, Benefits, Compliance, or HR Operations.

? Strong working knowledge of leave administration, ADA accommodations, employee relations practices, I-9 compliance, and general employment law; experience supporting multi-state employers is preferred.

? Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive, complex, and highly confidential matters with professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment.

? Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess facts, identify risks, and escalate issues appropriately.

? Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization.

? Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

? Experience working with HRIS platforms, case management systems, and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace applications, including strong Excel and documentation skills.

? Ability to work independently, exercise good judgment, and collaborate effectively with HR, management, and legal stakeholders.



Reporting Relationship

This position reports directly to the Benefits & Business Operation Manager and works closely with the Human Resources leadership team and the Company’s General Counsel on employee relations, compliance, and other sensitive HR matters.

Retail developments

Large steel structures

Precast and tilt-panel projects

Strong understanding of:

Structural steel fabrication

Steel detailing

Shop/fabrication drawings

General Arrangement drawings

Welding symbols

Construction and erection methods

Structural engineering documentation

Experience working on large-scale structural steel projects.

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

Residential drafting

Development Application drawings

General BIM modelling

BIM coordination

MEP coordination

Conceptual modelling

Architectural detailing

AutoCAD experience.

Navisworks experience.

Experience with other structural steel detailing software.

Experience with modern steel fabrication or automated fabrication processes.

Australian construction project experience.

Large industrial warehouse projects.

Retail and commercial structural steel projects.

Heavy structural steel.

Precast or tilt-panel construction.

Actual fabrication-level structural steel detailing.

Drawings the candidate personally produced.

Structural steel elements they personally detailed.

Whether the drawings were issued for fabrication/manufacturing.

The approximate project type and scale.

Their specific responsibilities.

Software used

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About the role



Move Abroad Coach is hiring a part-time Executive Assistant to take ownership of the business owner's inbox and calendar.



This is a focused support role, not a general VA role. The job is to keep the inbox clear, the calendar accurate, and open tasks tracked so that none of it depends on the business owner remembering it. This role reports to the business owner and to no one else. You'll coordinate with other team members on scheduling, but your priorities come from the business owner.



What you'll do



Inbox management (the core of the role)



Monitor the business owner's inbox daily and keep it organized

Flag what needs attention, and in what order

Use judgment on every

When escalating, do the work first — summarize the ask, pull the relevant context, and tee it up so it can be d

Follow up on threads that have gone quiet



Scheduling & calendar



Own the business owner's calendar — book, move, and confirm meetings

Coordinate with team members who need time on the calendar

Voice notes into action

Log each one where it belongs so nothing gets lost

Close the loop — confirm back what was captured and what's been handled



Task tracking (ClickUp)

Keep due dates and statuses current

Flag what's overdue, blocked, or about to slip



What success looks like



The inbox is reviewed every working day and nothing sits unanswered without a reason

Only the
s that genuinely need the business owner reach the business owner

The calendar reflects real priorities and respects stated working hours

Every voice note turns into a tracked task, not a lost thought

Nobody has to ask "did anyone follow up on that?"

Proven experience managing someone else's inbox and calendar (EA, VA, or ops support)

Strong written and spoken English — you'll be writing on the business owner's behalf and speaking with the team

The business owner works roughly 10:00–18:00 Central European Time, sometimes later, Monday - Thursday  This role requires a minimum of 4–6 hours of daily overlap with those hours. Please only apply if your schedule allows for that consistently.

Gmail, Google Calendar, ClickUp, Slack,

REMBOX is a team of architects, engineers, BIM managers, and visualizers united by an ambitious goal: to design beautiful cities and bring incredible projects to life with passion and professionalism. We collaborate with renowned studios from Israel and the USA, transforming large-scale ideas into reality. With over 500 staff across four offices in Belarus (Minsk, Brest, Grodno, and Gomel), REMBOX is expanding into the Philippines and seeking talented engineering professionals to join us.



We serve as a strategic partner for leading design organizations in Israel and the United States, delivering architectural, structural, MEP, and BIM services for large-scale projects across residential, commercial, public, industrial, and infrastructure sectors.



About the Role

REMBOX Philippines is looking for a skilled and motivated Electrical Power Supply Design Engineer. You will design internal and external power supply systems and produce complete electrical drawings and documentation for projects of various scales, collaborating with international project teams.



This is a technically focused engineering role for someone with a strong background in electrical power supply engineering, who is detail-oriented, collaborative, and driven to grow professionally within a world-class international company.



Key Responsibilities

External Power Supply Systems

Design external power supply infrastructure, including high and medium voltage networks, substations, transformer connections, and cable routing.

Design external distribution systems, including overhead lines, underground cable networks, switching stations, and metering points.

Produce drawings and documentation for external electrical networks: plans, cable routing layouts, schematic diagrams, and connection details.



Internal Power Supply Systems

Design internal low voltage distribution systems: main distribution boards, sub-distribution panels, busbar trunking, and cable distribution.

Design internal electrical systems for buildings: lighting, power outlets, socket layouts, emergency lighting, and UPS systems.

Design emergency and standby power systems: generator connections, automatic transfer switches, and critical load distribution.

Design earthing and lightning protection systems.

Produce internal electrical drawings: floor plans, riser diagrams, single-line diagrams, load calculations, and cable schedules.

Documentation & Coordination

Produce complete electrical engineering drawings and documentation using AutoCAD, including plans, schematics, single-line diagrams, sections, details, and specifications.

Develop and maintain electrical BIM models in Autodesk Revit where required, adhering to project BIM standards.

Create electrical designs for projects of various scales and typologies, including residential complexes, public buildings, office developments, industrial, and infrastructure.

Coordinate electrical designs with architectural, structural, mechanical, and plumbing disciplines to resolve clashes and ensure integration.

Ensure all designs comply with applicable international codes, standards, and project specifications.

Update documentation based on design revisions, coordination outcomes, and client feedback.

Participate in technical coordination meetings and contribute to project delivery.



Requirements

We are looking for candidates who meet the following qualifications:



Education & Experience

Higher technical education in Electrical Engineering or Power Supply Engineering.

Proven professional experience designing external and/or internal electrical power supply systems.

Experience producing complete electrical engineering drawings and documentation using AutoCAD.



Skills & Competencies — Must-Have

Strong proficiency in AutoCAD for electrical engineering drawing and documentation.

Solid understanding of external power supply system design (HV/MV networks, substations, cable routing, transformer connections).

Solid understanding of internal power supply system design (LV distribution, panels, lighting, power, emergency systems).

Ability to produce engineering drawings (plans, schematics, single-line diagrams, cable schedules, load calculations).

Understanding of electrical load analysis, short-circuit calculations, and protection coordination.

Strong attention to detail and diligence in completing assigned tasks accurately.

Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment.

Self-motivated with a genuine drive for professional growth.

Ability to manage workload and meet project deadlines independently.



Skills & Competencies — Strong Advantage

Experience with Autodesk Revit for MEP/electrical BIM modeling.

Familiarity with BIM coordination workflows and clash detection across disciplines.

Experience working on international projects or with international electrical design standards (IEC, NEC, Israeli standards).

Experience coordinating electrical designs with architects, structural engineers, and other MEP disciplines.

Experience with electrical design software for load calculations or network analysis.



Nice-to-Have

Experience with fire alarm systems, structured cabling, or building automation systems (BAS/BMS).

Background in renewable energy systems or EV charging infrastructure design.

Experience working in an international or remote team environment.

Familiarity with Israeli or US electrical design standards.

title: Finance Manager / Accounting Manager
description:
Facelove is a fast-growing DTC beauty brand in the US. We're direct-response first, the large majority of our revenue comes from paid acquisition, and every decision we make is measured against CAC, MER and contribution margin.

We're scaling quickly, and we're looking for a Head of Paid Media to own that growth: someone who has run serious spend before, knows what breaks at scale, and can build the system that gets us to the next level.



About the Role:



You'll own Facelove's finances: the close, the cash, the numbers everyone else makes decisions from.



This is a hands-on role, not a supervisory one. You'll do the reconciliations, build the models, and run the payment cycles yourself, while working alongside our external Dutch accountants on statutory filings. You'll report directly to the founder and COO.



The person who succeeds here is comfortable being the only finance person in the building. You'll set up the systems, then run them.



What you'll own





Full monthly close on a fixed calendar, with a close you can stand behind

Bank, payment processor and intercompany reconciliations

Chart of accounts, accrual policy, and the discipline to keep both clean as we scale

Documentation and audit trail good enough that a new person could pick it up

13-week rolling cash forecast, with paid media and inventory as the two variables that matter

Weekly cash position and runway, and early warning when something is drifting

Working capital: inventory purchase timing, supplier terms, processor payout cycles

Annual budget and quarterly reforecast, built with the founders and then held to

Unit economics and margin reporting

Contribution margin by channel, product and cohort, not just top-line P&L

The finance side of CAC, MER, AOV, LTV and payback, in partnership with paid media

Landed cost per unit and true gross margin, including freight, duties and 3PL fees

Calling out where we're losing money before it shows up in a quarterly number

Inventory accounting across manufacturing, freight and 3PL

COGS accuracy, standard cost maintenance, and variance analysis

Inventory reconciliation against 3PL reporting, including shrinkage and damages

Flagging stock and cash risk on reorders early enough to act on

Revenue recognition across Shopify and all payment methods

Processor reconciliation: fees, holds, reserves, payout timing

Refunds, chargebacks and disputes, tracked as a cost line with an owner

Subscription and repeat revenue reporting, if and as we build it

Monthly payment runs for a contractor-heavy team across multiple countries and currencies

Contractor documentation and compliance records, kept current rather than reconstructed

Accounts payable, vendor terms, and the discipline to pay correctly and on time

Working with HR on payroll verification, so hours, invoices and payments actually agree

Dutch statutory obligations for ODAQ B.V., managed with our external accountants

VAT filings and multi-currency treatment

US sales tax nexus and registrations as our footprint expands

Keeping us clean in every market we sell in, and telling us before a threshold becomes a problem

A monthly reporting pack a founder can read in ten minutes and trust

A weekly one-page view of cash, spend and margin

Ad hoc analysis that answers the question asked, with the assumptions visible



Skills Required: 



5+ years in accounting or finance, with at least 2 in ecommerce, DTC or consumer products

You have owned a monthly close yourself, not contributed to someone else's

Inventory and COGS accounting experience, including landed cost

Multi-currency and multi-entity experience, comfortable with FX and intercompany

Strong modelling ability in Excel or Google Sheets. You build the model, you don't just maintain someone else's tab

Fluency with Shopify or a comparable ecommerce platform, payment processors, and a cloud accounting system (Xero, QuickBooks, Exact or similar)

You can explain a variance to a non-finance founder without jargon and without hedging

Excellent written English, and the judgement to escalate things in writing before they become urgent



Strong plus



Experience with a Netherlands-registered entity, or comfort working with Dutch statutory requirements and external accountants

US sales tax nexus and multi-state registration experience

Beauty, skincare or supplements

High paid-media environments, where ad spend is the largest line and reconciles across four platforms

3PL and inventory planning exposure

CPA, ACCA, CIMA, CMA or local equivalent

You've been the first finance hire somewhere and built the function from a messy starting point



What we offer



- Real ownership of the most important function in the business, with a direct line to the founders

- Remote-first, async-friendly, results-measured

- A brand with genuine product-market fit and room to scale

title: Remote Rental Operations Manager — Miami Luxury Real Estate Team
description:
About the Role



Our Lead to Lease Team runs a tenant side transaction, luxury rental operation in Miami/Broward — high-end condos, demanding clients, caller, TC, marketing, and a bench of showing agents who need to be held accountable. We are building our foundation for Q4 and expanding across Florida in 2027. This is not property management. This is not bulk listings. We are in the business of moving deals, and every lead and every deal needs an owner, a next step, a deadline, and someone making sure it happens.



This role sits directly below the lead Real Estate Agent. You are the operational layer between the agent and the team. The agent sets direction and handles the high-value conversations. You make sure everything behind that runs clean: leads are moving, agents are following through, showings are confirmed, applications are in process, and nothing is sitting idle without a reason.



The rental business has its own workflow, its own pressure points, and its own failure modes. A generic manager who is good at attendance tracking and KPIs but has never worked a rental pipeline will not know where a deal is actually breaking. We need someone who understands — or can get up to speed fast on — how a lead becomes a showing, a showing becomes an application, an application becomes a CTL, and a CTL becomes a closed deal. And more importantly: who knows exactly where things fall apart along that path and how to fix it.



What You'll Do



Your job is simple to say and hard to execute: make sure every lead and every deal has an owner, a next step, a deadline, and accountability. That means:



- Monitor the full pipeline daily — lead response times, qualification status, showing coverage, application progress, transaction deadlines

- Run daily team check-ins: who owns what, what moved yesterday, what is stuck today

- Hold agents accountable for follow-through — if a showing agent goes quiet after a tour, that is your problem to solve

- Be the first answer for VAs — answer questions, correct output, escalate only what needs the agent

- Confirm every showing: access confirmed, tenant packet ready, agent briefed

- Manage the CRM — every lead in the right stage, every next action logged, no dead air

- Handle or escalate client communication issues before they become complaints

- Identify when something is a compliance or brokerage-level issue and flag it immediately

- Review applications, CTL paperwork, and transaction documents under agent direction

- Know at any moment where each active deal is stuck and who owns the next action (quickly)



What We're Looking For



This role requires both of the following — not one or the other:



Rental market experience — specifically in Miami luxury residential. You have worked in the rental space for a real estate agent: luxury condos, urban high-rises, HOA-managed buildings. You know what a CTL is, what RentSpree is, what an HOA approval process looks like, and what it means to move fast in a competitive lease situation. You understand that our clients are making high-stakes decisions and handle them accordingly. Property management, manufactured housing, suburban leasing, or bulk portfolio experience does not apply here.



People management experience. You have been responsible for whether other people got their work done — not just your own tasks. You have held a VA or showing agent accountable, run a team call, corrected someone's work, and followed through until it was right. You are comfortable owning a meeting and you do not disappear into the background when someone needs to be held to a commitment.



Additional requirements:



- You can look at a pipeline and immediately identify where a deal is stuck and who owns the next action

- You write clearly and professionally — no sloppy grammar in your own messages or documents

- You are proactive — you surface problems before they become emergencies

- CRM experience required (GoHighLevel preferred), Google Workspace, calendar tools

- You understand that this role reports directly to a licensed Real Estate Agent. This is a strong #2 position, not an autonomous executive role. You lead the team beneath you and execute.



You are NOT a fit if:



Your rental experience is outside of Miami luxury residential (manufactured housing, suburban PM, bulk portfolios)

Your background is purely execution — data entry, appointment setting — with no history of managing other people's work

You avoid team calls or prefer to stay in the background

You have changed jobs every 6 months

You expect commission or per-deal pay



Application Question (Required — answer in your message or your application will not be reviewed)



Tell us about a time a deal or lead fell through the cracks on your team. What stage was it in, why did it happen, and what did you do about it?



To Apply



Send your resume, your answer to the application question, your availability, and your target monthly rate. To be considered reach out to Vincent directly on WhatsApp 
and send a short note here so he can review your profile. If you do not follow this you will not get a message back.

title: Project Manager – eCommerce Operations & Asana Workflow Expert
description:
SUMMARY  

Hi! I’m looking for someone who thrives on structure, efficiency, and systems. You love creating clarity out of complexity and ensuring every moving part works seamlessly together. You're fluent in Asana, experienced in operations, and obsessed with process optimization.

You’ll play a key role in coordinating efforts across internal teams and external partners to ensure projects move forward smoothly and on schedule. From handing off tasks to the right tea
mbers to tracking progress and resolving blockers, you’ll help keep everything aligned. Your work will directly contribute to creating a seamless, high-quality experience for every pediatrician we serve.



WHO WE ARE  

We are Pediatrics Board Review (PBR), a company led by a physician (me) that helps pediatricians pass their board exams.

We’re not just a content provider. We are a lifeline for overwhelmed, high-achieving doctors who have devoted their lives to helping children but now need help themselves to overcome one of the most stressful challenges in their careers: board certification.

We’ve helped more than 10,000 pediatricians, including many who failed for over 10 years, finally pass.



Our system combines:

• High-yield medical education

• Multimodal learning (books, video, audio)

• Test-taking strategy and mindset coaching

• Deep, compassionate support for physicians under pressure



We’re a small, mission-driven team making a real difference. Every process we refine, every system we improve, and every customer experience we optimize directly impacts the lives of physicians. And by extension, their patients.



OUR CORE VALUES  

We care more about how you work than how flashy your resume looks. Our best tea
mbers lead with humility, take ownership, and always act in service of the mission.



• NO DRAMA: Humble, flexible, team player, coachable

• ALTRUISM: Selfless, compassionate, radically honest

• INITIATIVE: Growth mindset, proactive, innovative

• INTELLIGENCE: Strategic thinker, articulate, detail-oriented

• EXCELLENCE: Hardworking, dependable, consistent, high integrity



If these resonate, you’ll likely thrive here.



WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS  

Our mission to help pediatricians succeed relies on strong systems and seamless coordination behind the scenes. These systems make it possible for our customers to receive exactly what they need, when they need it, without confusion or delays.



This role is all about ensuring that those systems run smoothly across departments. You won’t be doing the hands-on work in marketing, member success, or tech, but you will be the one making sure each team knows what needs to happen, by when, and why. You’ll track timelines, remove bottlenecks, and ensure accountability across different teams so that projects move forward on target.



When you do your job well, our team operates with greater clarity and focus, freeing up more pediatricians to study, learn, and pass without the distraction of tech hiccups, missed communications, or operational slowdowns.



WHAT YOU WILL DO  

You will work closely with me (the CEO), our internal tea
mbers, and external partners to ensure clarity, consistency, and timely execution across all operational initiatives. Your role is to coordinate efforts, delegate tasks, and keep everyone aligned and accountable, so nothing falls through the cracks (because right now, things are falling through the cracks!).



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



ASANA-BASED PROJECT MANAGEMENT

• Create and maintain Asana boards to track all operational initiatives

• Assign and monitor tasks across departments (member success team, tech, external partners)

• Build templates, SOPs, and workflows to standardize recurring projects

• Manage timelines and ensure deliverables stay on track



CROSS-TEAM COORDINATION

• Monitor Asana boards and project areas to track progress and priorities

• Coordinate with internal teams and partner agencies to move projects forward

• Troubleshoot slowdowns or disconnects between different teams and external partner agencies

• Ensure timely communication and clear expectations across all parties



SYSTEMS AND PROCESS OPTIMIZATION

• Map and document processes end-to-end for clarity and scalability

• Propose and implement automation or integrations to save time and reduce errors



PERFORMANCE TRACKING AND REPORTING

• Provide regular reports and recommendations for improvement

• Ensure accountability and transparency in how projects are executed



YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT IF

• You’re highly organized and detail-obsessed. Nothing slips through the cracks.

• You’re fluent in Asana and have experience managing complex systems.

• You’ve managed cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders.

• You love optimizing processes, building SOPs, and creating structure.

• You stay calm and solutions-focused under pressure.

• You’re accountable, proactive, and clear in your communication.

• You thrive in a remote team environment and deliver reliably.

• You care deeply about impact and helping a small team make a big difference.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

• You dislike systems, tools, or structure

• You struggle to meet deadlines or manage multiple priorities

• You wait for instructions instead of anticipating needs

• You find documentation and follow-up tedious

• You’re juggling many other clients or projects

• You struggle with receiving open and honest feedback



FINAL NOTE  

This role is about more than operational efficiency. It’s about creating a better experience for the physicians we serve. These are people whose success changes lives.

If you’re excited to build systems that make a real impact, thrive on creating order from chaos, and love helping a team deliver its best work with precision and heart, we would love to meet you.

Looking forward to connecting!

title: Video Editor for Creator/UGC Ads (Meta, 9:16) — Part-Time, Long-Term, Day Shift
description:
ABOUT US



We are a pet supplement brand launching in Australia. Dog health. We run paid ads on Meta. Our brand is built on being honest: no fake urgency, no fake before-and-after, no medical claims. Our ads look like real dog owners talking, not like commercials.



Our team works from the Netherlands. We sell into Australia. For you that means two things. First, your hours are flexible - editing is async work and we do not need you online at a fixed time. No graveyard shift, no fixed shift at all. What we need is a reply within 24 hours and deadlines that hold. Second, our ads have to sound Australian, and that is the one thing we are strict about.



We want ONE editor to grow with us. Start small, scale as we scale.



WHAT YOU WILL EDIT



Creator footage. Real Australian dog owners film their own dogs on their phones and send us the raw clips. You turn that into ads. You will never be asked to shoot anything, write anything, or generate anything.



Three types, all 9:16 vertical.



1) TOF (cold audience), 15-30 seconds

- Native, phone-shot feel. NOT a polished commercial

- Hook in the first 3 seconds. No logo intro, no brand animation

- Fast cuts, every 2-3 seconds. Lots of dog b-roll

- Important: these ads never show or name the product

- Goal: stop the scroll



2) MOF (warm audience), 45-120 seconds

- Mechanism explainers, comparisons, testimonials

- Slower cuts, every 4-6 seconds

- On-screen text overlays, simple graphics, side-by-side layouts

- Goal: handle objections and build trust



3) BOF (ready to buy), 15-40 seconds - later in the project

- Short, one objection each: guarantee, price per day, "will my dog even eat it"

- Usually one creator clip plus text



You get: the raw creator footage, a written script with timecodes, a hook list, reference ads and a caption spec. You do not write scripts. You edit.



WHAT WE NEED



- 2+ years editing short-form vertical ads for Meta / TikTok / Reels

- You can show ads you edited that actually RAN as paid ads

- Premiere Pro or CapCut. After Effects is a plus, not required

- You are good with messy input: phone clips at different resolutions, bad audio, vertical and horizontal mixed, no slate, no organisation. This is most of the job. Creator footage is never tidy

- You can style captions properly (see our spec below)

- You deliver 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1 exports

- You can cut 5 hook variations on the same body edit. Same video, five different first-3-seconds, five files. This is our main workflow, not an occasional request

- Good written English. You reply within 24 hours

- Reliable internet, you meet deadlines



ONE THING WE WILL NOT DO



We do not fake results. No stitched-together before-and-afters that imply a change that did not happen, no borrowed footage passed off as our customers, no invented testimonials. Our brand is built on not misleading people, and that rule is not flexible. If a brief ever seems to cross it, say so - we will thank you.



ONE THING THAT MATTERS



Our ads are Australian. The captions say "mum", not "mom". "Kilos", not "pounds". Getting this wrong is the fastest way to fail the test project.



CAPTIONS - OUR SPEC



- Phrase-level. No word-by-word pop, no bounce, no karaoke highlight. Our audience is 35-65, reading at night. Calm and large beats trendy

- Heavy geometric sans (Montserrat ExtraBold / Poppins Bold / Inter Black). Not the CapCut default font

- ~72px, max 4 words per card, never 3 lines

- All text between y=420 and y=1420 on a 1080x1920 canvas

- White with a 5px black stroke, or a dark plate. Half our footage is a dog in Australian sun and white-on-bright is unreadable

- One highlighted word per card, maximum

- Deliver burned-in AND a separate .srt



NICE TO HAVE



- Pet, health or supplement brand experience

- You have cut UGC or creator content before, not just brand video

- Basic motion graphics

- Light audio cleanup (creator phone audio is often rough)



THE ROLE AND THE PAY



- $6 USD per hour

- Part-time to start: roughly 10-15 hours a week, growing if it goes well

- Flexible hours. No fixed shift. We work from the Netherlands, so we are not going to ask you to be online at 3am for a call

- We agree a time budget per video before you start it - for example "this one should be around 2.5 hours". If you are going to go over, message us first. We are reasonable about it. We just do not want surprises on either side

- Paid weekly. Always on time



HOW WE WORK



- Paid test project first: 1 video, we pay $25, whether we continue or not

- If it works: 10 videos over 3 weeks, with written feedback after each one

- If that works: ongoing, growing hours, and a rate review after 3 months

- We give specific feedback, never "make it better"



HOW TO APPLY



Send a message with:



1. The words BLUE DOG as the first line (applications without this are deleted - we only work with people who read)

2. 3 links to short-form ADS you edited. Paid social ads, not weddings, not vlogs, not YouTube intros

3. For ONE of those links: 2 sentences on why the first 3 seconds work

4. Honestly: how many hours does one 25-second UGC ad take you, from raw creator clips to final export with captions? We are not testing for the smallest number. We want to know you know your own pace

5. Your hourly rate in USD, and how many hours a week you can commit



We reply to everyone who follows these five steps.

title: OpenClaw Agent Engineer - Build AI Agents and Keep Them Running
description:
READ THIS FIRST

 

You must have used OpenClaw before. You must be able to prove it.

 

If you have not used OpenClaw, please do not apply. We will not read your message. We are saying this clearly so we do not waste your time or ours.

 

 

THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE

 

You build OpenClaw agents. You keep them running. You make them faster, cheaper and more reliable every week.

 

That is the whole job.

 

 

ABOUT US

 

We are a health and wellness company. We sell products online. We have a small remote team in several countries.

 

We are building a team of AI agents to run parts of our business.

 

 

WHAT IS AN AGENT HERE

 

An agent is a small program that does one job. It runs by itself on a timer. Nobody starts it by hand. It runs at 3am while everyone is asleep.

 

We want 10 to 20 agents. Each one does one job.

 

Three real examples:

 

1) STORE WATCHER. Every 3 hours it checks our online shop. Is checkout working? Is any product priced wrong? Are we selling stock we do not have? If yes, it reports. If no, it says nothing.

 

2) INBOX READER. Twice a day it reads
, Slack, Asana and meeting notes. It works out what is waiting on the owner. Then it writes the replies for him to approve.

 

3) COMPETITOR WATCHER. Once a week it checks what our competitors changed. It only reports the changes.

 

Above all the agents sits one main agent. We call it the Chief of Staff. It manages the other agents. It is the only agent that talks to the owner.

 

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 

1) BUILD THE PLATFORM. One AWS account. OpenClaw installed and running on a timer. A safe place to store passwords and API keys. A log of every run. A stop button.

 

2) BUILD THE AGENTS. One at a time. We give you a written brief for each one. You d
 how to build it.

 

3) KEEP THEM RUNNING. This is half the job. An agent that stops quietly is worse than no agent at all, because we will trust a silence that means nothing is being checked.

 

4) MAKE THEM BETTER EVERY WEEK.

- Using too much money? Make them cheaper.

- Too slow? Make them faster.

- Sending too many messages? Reduce the noise.

- Failing sometimes? Find out why and fix it.

 

You will send a short report every week: how many runs, how many failures, how much it cost, and what you improved.

 

5) OWN IT. You will be the only person who understands this system. We need you to write things down so that stays safe.

 

 

YOU MUST HAVE

 

1) OPENCLAW EXPERIENCE. This is not optional. You have installed OpenClaw yourself. You have run it. You have fixed it when it broke. We need proof. See the PROOF section below.

 

2) AWS. You have set up EC2 yourself. You know IAM. You have used Secrets Manager or something like it.

 

3) PYTHON. You write code that runs on a server. Not only in a notebook.

 

4) API EXPERIENCE. REST APIs. OAuth. Webhooks. You have handled rate limits and retries. You have worked with an API that gave you wrong data.

 

5) LLM API EXPERIENCE. OpenAI, Anthropic or similar. Inside real code. Not only in a chat window.

 

6) CLEAR WRITTEN ENGLISH. Most of our work is written. You must be able to explain a technical decision in writing.

 

7) TIME OVERLAP. At least 4 hours per day that overlap with Sydney, Australia business hours.

 

 

PROOF OF OPENCLAW EXPERIENCE

 

Your application must include at least one of these. Two is better.

 

OPTION A - A SHORT SCREEN RECORDING. 2 to 3 minutes. Record your own screen. Show OpenClaw running on your machine or your server. Show the config. Show the logs. Show it doing something.

 

OPTION B - A REPOSITORY. A GitHub link with your commit history, showing your OpenClaw setup or an agent you built for it.

 

OPTION C - A LIVE SYSTEM. Something running now that we can look at, or that you can show us on a call.

 

Screenshots alone are not enough. Anyone can send a screenshot. We need to see you working with it.

 

AND ANSWER THESE FIVE QUESTIONS. These are simple if you have really used it. Please answer all five.

 

1) Did you install OpenClaw yourself, or did you use a one-click hosting service or a template? Both answers are fine. We just need to know which one.

 

2) What machine did it run on? Say the operating system and where it was hosted.

 

3) How did you keep it running after you closed your laptop or logged out? Name the exact method you used.

 

4) Where do you look when you want to see what OpenClaw did? Name the file or the command.

 

5) Tell us about one time it broke. What broke, and how did you fix it?

 

 

PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF

 

- You have never used OpenClaw

- You cannot show us proof

- You have only used no-code tools and never written code that runs on a server

- You want a job where every task is fully explained before you start

- You are sending the same message to many jobs today

 

 

ONE MORE THING, AND WE MEAN IT

 

We need you to tell us the truth about what you can and cannot do.

 

If something is too hard for you today, say so. We will pay for the course. We will give you the time.

 

What we cannot work with is a date that was never real, or a yes that was really a maybe.

 

Before you start each piece of work, we will ask you to rate it from 1 to 10. 1 is very easy. 10 is very hard. We want the real number. If it is an 8, say 8.

 

This is a real part of the job. It is not a nice sentence in a job advert.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Send a message with all five things below. If anything is missing, we will not read it.

 

1) Start your message with the word HEARTBEAT. This shows us you read the post.

 

2) Your proof of OpenClaw experience. Recording, repository or live system.

 

3) Your answers to the five OpenClaw questions above.

 

4) Your answers to these three questions. Short answers are better than long ones.

 

   a) Tell us about one program you built that ran by itself for 30 days or more. Something broke while nobody was watching. How did you find out it had broken?

 

   b) Your program runs at 3am. Nobody is logged in. It needs an API key to do its job. Where do you keep that key, and why there?

 

   c) Twenty different agents all send messages to one busy person. After one month, that person stops reading them. What do you build so this does not happen?

 

5) Your rate. USD per month, for 40 hours per week.

 

Please write your application yourself. We read a lot of AI writing every day. We are hiring for good thinking, not for good grammar.

 

 

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

 

1) We read your proof and your answers.

2) A 30 minute video call.

3) A paid test project. One week. One small agent. We pay your normal rate. You keep the money even if we do not continue.

4) If it goes well, full time and long term.

title: Site Manager
description:
WE ARE NOT AN AGENCY, THIS IS A DIRECT HIRE

Remote work to start > converted to On-site in Manila on October or November



This is a senior leadership role responsible for establishing and managing REMBOX's regional operations in the Philippines. The Site Manager will be the most senior person on the ground, building the Manila office from its foundation and leading all production teams to ensure the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and professionalism.



About REMBOX

REMBOX is an international architectural and engineering company that partners with leading design organizations in Israel and the United States. We are a team of architects, engineers, BIM managers, and visualizers dedicated to designing innovative cities and bringing large-scale projects to life. With over 500 staff across four offices in Belarus, REMBOX is expanding into the Philippines and seeks a strong leader to establish and manage the new Manila office.



Core Guiding Principle

"People in our hearts, clients are on our minds, and quality and professionalism are in our bones."



The Site Manager must ensure all employees embody this principle, maintaining high-quality standards, strict adherence to deadlines, and a strong client focus.



Three Primary Focus Areas

Professionalism & Client Orientation: Minimize client complaints regarding quality control and project deadlines.

People Development & Well-Being: Maintain low employee turnover (max 8%), foster growth, ensure good communication, and provide a positive work environment.

Company Representation & Values: Uphold and promote the REMBOX brand, integrity, and values, acting as the company's primary representative.

About the Role

This founding leadership role operates in two distinct phases:



Phase 1: Establishment Phase (Months 1-4 approx.)

Focus: Heavy administrative tasks including office setup, equipment sourcing, service provider selection, lease negotiation, and vendor management to establish the Philippines entity and operationalize the office.

Phase 2: Management Phase (Month 4+ onwards)

Focus: Full regional leadership, managing production teams, Team Leads, KPIs, BIM standards, HR processes, office administration, and reporting to global leadership. The focus shifts to running and optimizing the region.

This role requires a leader comfortable with both hands-on operational groundwork and strategic C-suite engagement.



Key Responsibilities



Management of Production Teams:

Coordinate Team Leads, conduct syncs, manage risks, allocate clients/projects, and resolve issues.

Monitor production performance, quality control, and reporting; resolve issues promptly.

Ensure regional workload delivery, optimize team utilization, and meet output plans.



Cooperation with the BIM Department:

Ensure team compliance with BIM standards and oversee BIM Department performance.

Plan and oversee the execution of regional BIM tasks

.

Interaction with the REMBOX Academy:

Monitor Team Lead adherence to Academy standards and methodologies.

Provide feedback to the Academy on training effectiveness and contribute to new system development.

Participate in training new and existing Team Leads.



People Management - HR & Talent:

Participate in recruitment by assessing new employees and managing assignments.

Support retention by resolving conflicts and addressing burnout/motivation issues.

Propose promotions, professional development, and participate in employee evaluations.



Administrative Management of the Region:

Office Setup & Establishment (Philippines-specific): Lead end-to-end office setup, including space negotiation, supplier engagement, and coordination with Corporate Admin and CEO on compliance and financial setup.

Manage System Administrators and coordinate with central IT.

Monitor and enforce office security, data confidentiality, and workplace safety.

Oversee adherence to workplace rules, including working hours, vacation, and sick leave processes.

Manage the local budget, office expenses, and equipment purchases.



Reporting to Global Leadership (CEO, CFO, COO):

Report on regional KPIs (output, deadlines, quality, turnover).

Provide early risk reporting (delays, client issues, staff shortages).

Participate in strategic planning (growth forecasts, resource needs).

Escalate urgent, critical issues.



Must-Have:

Proven experience leading regional operations or large production teams.

Strong organizational and workflow control skills (deadlines, quality, reporting, problem-solving).

Experience managing resource allocation in a multi-project environment.

Ability to analyze team performance and intervene effectively.

Experience in technical or standards-driven environments (e.g., BIM).

Strong people-management skills.

Experience managing office operations through an Office Manager and SysAdmin.

Understanding of workplace safety, data confidentiality, and internal regulations.

Ability to oversee adherence to working-time rules, vacations, and sick leaves.

Experience handling a local budget.

Strong focus on KPIs.

Proactive risk identification and escalation skills.

Experience working directly with C-level executives.

High sense of ownership.

Excellent communication skills in English.



Nice-to-Have:

Background in architecture, engineering, construction, or AEC industry.

Experience setting up a new office or regional entity from scratch.

Experience sourcing and engaging service providers.

Experience with lease negotiations, vendor management, and supplier evaluation.

Experience working with BIM-driven engineering or design teams.

Familiarity with outsourcing or BPO-style production environments.

Experience managing cross-cultural or international teams.

Experience with talent development, internal academies, or training program implementation.



What REMBOX Offers

A founding leadership role as the most senior REMBOX representative in the Philippines.

Direct reporting line and collaboration with the global CEO, CFO, and COO.

The opportunity to build a new operation from the ground up.

A high-visibility, high-impact role.

Official employment: starts as a B2B contract, transitioning to direct employment.

Exposure to an international company culture.

Long-term career opportunity.

title: Sales & Outreach VA | Cold Calling & Appointment Setting
description:
Galleon Web is a web agency serving local service businesses in the United States.



We are looking for a Sales & Outreach VA to handle day-to-day outbound outreach and generate qualified sales appointments.



This is a part-time position: 4 hours/day, 5 days/week (20 hours/week) with the opportunity to move to full-time after approximately 2 months based on performance and workload.



Main Responsibilities



Your highest-priority responsibility will be cold calling and appointment setting.

* Handle common objections naturally.

* Qualify interested prospects.

* Book qualified appointments.

* Schedule callbacks and complete follow-ups.

* Confirm appointments.

* Update our Google Sheets CRM accurately.

* Instagram/Facebook DMs

For businesses with weak websites, you may record short personalized Loom videos explaining specific problems you noticed and use them as part of the outreach process.

Secondary Responsibilities

* Respond to basic social engagement.

Social media management is secondary. We are hiring a salesperson/outreach VA first.



Who We Want



We strongly prefer someone who already has experience:



* Cold calling US local service businesses or trades.

* Speaking directly with small-business owners.

* Appointment setting.

* Handling objections.

* Managing callbacks and follow-ups.

* Using a CRM or sales tracker.



Experience calling industries such as remodeling, construction, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, home services, or similar local businesses is a major advantage.



Agency, web-design, marketing, SEO, or general B2B sales experience is also useful.

* Reliable internet.

* Good headset.

Plus:

GALLEON

description:

About Benoz.AI -

Benoz.AI is an Israeli company building a multi-tenant SaaS platform for nonprofit and social-sector organisations. For years we delivered custom systems to clients one at a time; we are now replacing that portfolio with a single AI-powered platform, built on an architecture that is already designed and documented.



The role -

You will be the first engineer on the platform: writing the first production code, building the first client module end to end, and setting the engineering standards (code review, testing, deployment) that the team we hire after you will inherit. You will work directly with the founding team, and we expect you to push back when something in the design deserves it.

This is an AI-first development role. We build fast with AI tools like Claude Code across the whole workflow: planning, coding, testing, reviewing. Working this way is a core part of the job, and knowing where the tools stop being useful matters as much as using them.



Who you are -

• At least 5 years of full stack development experience, including at least one system you took from an empty repository to production and kept running

• Experienced in AI-assisted development: you already build with tools like Claude Code daily, and you can show it

• Leadership experience: a tech lead, or the person others came to for direction

• Excellent English, written and spoken: some of our work is asynchronous and written, and you will also be in regular calls with the team

• Self-managing: you plan your own work, communicate progress without being chased, and raise flags early when something is off

• Ownership mindset: you treat the platform as yours, including quality, security, and deadlines



Required technical experience -

• TypeScript, Next.js, React: in production, full stack, not just frontend

• Supabase: schema design, indexing, JSONB, Row-Level Security, auth, storage

• Deployment & infrastructure: Vercel or similar serverless platforms, and traditional Node.js servers (Docker, Render, AWS or similar)

• Queues & background jobs: BullMQ, QStash, Inngest or similar; retries, idempotency

• Auth & API design: JWT/OAuth, RBAC, REST, rate limiting

• Testing: unit and integration (Vitest, Jest, Playwright or similar)

• AI APIs: Anthropic, OpenAI or similar, integrated into product features



Nice to have -

Multi-tenant SaaS or configurable platform experience, pgvector / RAG, Sentry or similar observability, Tailwind, webhooks and third-party integrations 
, SMS, payments).



Hours & engagement -

• Scope: part-time to start (4 hours/day, Mon–Fri), moving to full-time within ~2 months

• Part-time schedule: 9:00–13:00 Philippine time (overlapping US hours)

• Full-time schedule: Israel business hours, 9:00–17:00 Israel time (14:00–22:00 Philippine time)

• Long-term role, not a project

title: Book Marketing Blogger & Review Specialist
description:
Summary



I am seeking a detail-oriented and creative Book Marketing Blogger & Review Specialist to help increase the visibility of my books through ethical marketing, high-quality reviews, SEO-optimized blog content, and strategic promotion. The ideal candidate will have excellent writing skills, strong research abilities, and an understanding of how online communities and book promotion platforms operate.



This position requires someone who can follow platform policies, produce engaging content, identify marketing opportunities, and provide ongoing reporting on book performance.



Primary Responsibilities



Book Reviews (Using Book Bounty - Information will be provided)



* Complete a minimum of **10 book reviews per week**.

* Use **Book Bounty** to locate available review opportunities.

* Select books through **Kindle Unlimited** or **Free Download** promotions.

* Free Download Review (no more than three books per review cycle)  before selecting additional books during a cycle.

* Read sufficient portions of each book to provide an honest, thoughtful, and useful review.

* Write original reviews that reflect your genuine assessment of the book.

* When available conduct "Book Cover" reviews and submit my book covers to the page.

* Submit each review for supervisor approval before posting when required.





Blog Writing & SEO



* Write SEO-optimized blog posts designed to increase book visibility and organic search traffic.

* Research keywords and incorporate SEO best practices into every article.

* Create engaging content that introduces books, authors, genres, and reading recommendations.

* Learn and apply current SEO techniques to improve search rankings.

* Continuously improve blog performance through keyword research and content optimization.



Book Promotion



* Advertise books on approved websites and online communities.

* Research and understand each website's rules, policies, and submission guidelines before posting.

* Ensure all promotional activities comply with individual platform policies.

* Avoid actions that could result in rejected submissions or account violations.

* Identify new promotional websites and communities that may increase book exposure.





Review Management



* Monitor reviews across all published books.

* Apply available review opportunities through **My Books** and other approved review platforms.

* Help ensure books consistently receive new, authentic reader reviews.

* Research additional legitimate sources that can generate increased book reviews.

* Avoid excessive reliance on AI-generated reviews or content that may increase rejection rates.

* Ensure all reviews and promotional content remain original and comply with platform guidelines.



Performance Monitoring



* Track the number of reviews each book receives.

* Prepare a monthly review audit for every published title.

* Identify books receiving limited visibility or declining engagement.

* Highlight negative reviews requiring author attention.

* Identify recurring themes within reviews that may indicate opportunities for improving:



  * Book descriptions

  * Covers

  * Formatting

  * Content

  * Reader expectations

  * Keywords

  * Categories





Reporting



Provide weekly reports including:



* Books reviewed

* Blogs published

* Promotional sites utilized

* SEO activities completed

* Review opportunities submitted

* Review approvals received

* Marketing recommendations

* New promotional opportunities discovered



Provide monthly reports including:



* Total reviews gained

* Review trends

* Books gaining momentum

* Books needing additional promotion

* Negative review summaries

* Recommendations for improving visibility and reader satisfaction





Qualifications



* Excellent written English.

* Strong proofreading and editing skills.

* Basic understanding of SEO principles.

* Ability to research and follow website policies.

* Experience writing blogs, reviews, or online articles preferred.

* Familiarity with Kindle Unlimited and Amazon books preferred.

* Strong organizational and time management skills.

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

* Professional communication skills.



---



## Performance Expectations



Each week, the successful candidate is expected to:



* Complete at least **10 quality book reviews**.

* Publish SEO-focused blog content as assigned.

* Promote books on approved platforms while following all posting guidelines.

* Research additional opportunities to improve book visibility.

* Maintain accurate tracking of all promotional activities.

* Provide timely updates to the supervisor regarding campaign performance and review progress.



---



## Success Measures



Performance will be evaluated based on:



* Quality and originality of book reviews.

* Compliance with platform rules and policies.

* Growth in book visibility.

* Increase in authentic reader reviews.

* SEO performance of blog articles.

* Consistency of weekly reporting.

* Initiative in identifying new promotional opportunities.

* Ability to provide actionable recommendations that improve book sales and reader engagement.



---



## Additional Responsibilities



Additional marketing and promotional duties may be assigned as needed to support book launches, increase author recognition, improve online visibility, and expand reader engagement. Flexibility, creativity, and a proactive approach to discovering new marketing opportunities are highly valued.

title: Senior YouTube Strategist & Producer
description:
Faceless Long-Form Channels



Preferred location/time zone: The Americas, particularly LATAM, Canada or the United States



About the Role



We are looking for a senior, hands-on YouTube Strategist and Producer to lead content strategy, creative development and day-to-day production across multiple established and emerging faceless YouTube channels.



Our channels create long-form documentary-style content for predominantly U.S. audiences, covering ships, aviation, U.S. presidents, military history and related subjects.



This is not simply an upload-management or YouTube SEO role. You will d
 what we create, develop the packaging and content direction, screen scripts, coordinate footage, manage production deadlines and ensure every video is accurate, engaging and ready for publication across YouTube and our other social platforms.



You will be accountable for both the quality of the production operation and achievement of ambitious channel-growth targets.



About Us



We are a European media company producing high-quality faceless content for English-speaking audiences.



We value originality, factual accuracy, strong storytelling and continuous improvement. We offer a collaborative environment where good ideas are welcomed, performance is measured objectively and every team member is encouraged to improve how we work.



YTMG LTD is hiring a full-time Senior YouTube Strategist & Producer to grow three faceless long-form channels covering ships, aviation, U.S. presidents and military history for a primarily U.S. audience.



You will own the full content loop: idea, package, script, production, publication and post-launch analysis - while leading writers, voice actors, editors and thumbnail designers.



What you will own



Strategy and ideas -Use CTR, AVD, retention, traffic-source and audience data to find opportunities, choose topics and create clear briefs for scriptwriters.



Packaging and retention -Develop high-impact titles and thumbnail concepts; improve hooks, pacing, structure and visual progression.



Editorial quality -Screen scripts, fact-check claims and coordinate the use of licensed, public-domain and original footage.



Production leadership -Manage deadlines and quality across scriptwriters, voice actors, editors and thumbnail designers; resolve blockers early.



Calls and reporting - Prepare and lead weekly production calls with performance insights, priorities, decisions, owners and deadlines.



Publishing -Oversee final QA and publishing across YouTube and major social platforms.



What success looks like



More videos reach 400,000+ organic views within 30 days.



Within 90 days, monthly long-form views move from 6.6M to 10M, 12.6M to 20M and 71k to 4M across the three channels.



U.S. audience share stays at or above 45%, 55% and 60% respectively, while India remains below 10%.



What we need



3+ years in YouTube strategy, channel management or production. Exceptional candidates with 2 years and standout evidence will be considered.



Proven long-form growth results, with links and a clear explanation of what you personally changed.



Strong command of YouTube Studio, packaging, retention and content positioning.



Experience leading writers, voice actors, editors and designers against deadlines.



Excellent fact-checking, visual judgment, English communication and ownership.



What we offer



Remote, full-time work with a preference for candidates in the U.S., Canada or LATAM. Base pay is $1,500 USD per month, plus bonuses tied to 24-hour video performance, 30-day view targets, monthly channel growth and U.S. audience share.



How to apply



Add two or three relevant channels or long-form videos;



the decisions you personally owned and the measurable results; and



your location, time zone, availability and confirmation that the compensation works for you.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a structured two-hour work sample covering analytics, strategy, script screening and production operations.



EQUAL OPPORTUNITY



We evaluate applicants on evidence, judgment and their ability to perform the role. We welcome qualified applicants from all backgrounds.
