title: PayPal & Shopify Dispute Manager
description:
About us

We're a growing direct-to-consumer footwear brand selling in the US market. We run a lean operation and take customer experience seriously — which means when a dispute lands, we want it handled fast, professionally, and with a strong chance of winning.



What we're looking for

We need an experienced dispute specialist who knows PayPal's resolution process and Shopify's chargeback flow inside and out — someone who has handled chargebacks and "Item Not Received" / "Item Not as Described" claims repeatedly and knows exactly what evidence to submit, how to frame responses, and how to maximize win rates.



This is not a role for someone learning on the job. We want a proven operator.



What you'll do

-Respond to and manage PayPal disputes

-Handle credit card chargebacks submitted directly through Shopify Payments

-Gather and submit the right evidence (tracking info, order details, correspondence) in a compelling, structured way

-Keep us informed of case status and outcome

-Flag any patterns you notice (e.g. a spike in a certain dispute type)



Volume & commitment

Current volume is around 5 disputes/month, growing as we scale. This is an on-call arrangement — we are not looking for a fixed weekly commitment. We're open to hearing your preferred rate structure (per dispute, hourly, or monthly retainer) in your proposal.



You're a great fit if you:

-Have handled PayPal disputes and Shopify credit card chargebacks for DTC eCommerce brands

-Can show a concrete win rate or track record (please include this in your proposal)

-Understand PayPal's Seller Protection policies and Shopify's chargeback response process

-Are responsive — disputes have deadlines and we move fast



How to apply

To filter out generic applications, your proposal must include both of the following:

-Describe a dispute you won that initially looked difficult. What was the claim type, what evidence did you use, and what was the outcome?

-Attach screenshots or documentation showing disputes you have handled — this can be anonymized win/loss records, a dispute dashboard, resolved case summaries, or similar. Proposals without proof of work will not be considered.

title: Operations & Project Management Virtual Assistant
description:
Company: Peakfinity Labs

Position: Operations & Project Management Virtual Assistant

Type: Full-Time

Remote Position



About Peakfinity Labs



Peakfinity Labs is a rapidly growing supplement manufacturing and product development company helping brands bring their products from concept to market.



We're looking for a highly organized, proactive Operations & Project Management VA to help manage client projects, coordinate with our fulfillment and packaging partners, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



This is not a basic data-entry VA position.



You'll be responsible for keeping projects moving, following up with multiple parties, communicating updates to clients, and making sure deadlines and deliverables are being met.



What You'll Be Responsible For



Client Project Management



Manage and track active client projects from onboarding through production and fulfillment



Keep project timelines, statuses, and next steps organized and up to date



Follow up with clients when we need approvals, information, artwork, payments, or other deliverables



Provide clients with clear and professional project updates



Identify projects that are stalled and proactively work to get them moving again



Keep our internal team updated on important client issues, delays, and upcoming deadlines



Supplier & Packaging Coordination



Communicate with packaging suppliers regarding bottles, labels, boxes, pouches, and other packaging components



Request and follow up on quotes, lead times, proofs, production statuses, and shipping information



Track packaging orders and make sure components arrive when they're needed



Coordinate artwork/proof approvals between clients, suppliers, and our team



Flag potential delays before they become bigger problems



ShipVelocity & Fulfillment Coordination



Communicate directly with ShipVelocity regarding client inventory and fulfillment



Coordinate inbound shipments and inventory arriving at the fulfillment center



Follow up on receiving and inventory discrepancies



Help troubleshoot fulfillment-related issues



Make sure clients and our internal team receive accurate updates regarding fulfillment and inventory



Operations



Maintain organized project management systems for every active client



Update project statuses, deadlines, notes, and outstanding action items



Follow up with vendors and partners without needing to be reminded



Keep documents, quotes, invoices, proofs, and project information organized



Create simple SOPs and improve processes as we grow



Help our team identify bottlenecks and keep operations running smoothly



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is:



Extremely organized



A strong written English communicator



Proactive and comfortable following up with people repeatedly



Comfortable communicating directly with clients and vendors



Able to manage many projects simultaneously without losing track of details



Good at identifying what needs to happen next without waiting for instructions



Reliable with deadlines and follow-ups



Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment



Able to solve basic problems independently before escalating them



Experience with project management, operations, manufacturing, logistics, fulfillment, e-commerce, or supply-chain coordination is a major plus.



Experience in the supplement, CPG, manufacturing, or 3PL industry is an even bigger plus.



Tools You May Work With



Depending on the project, you'll work with tools such as:



Slack



Google Workspace



Project management software






Spreadsheets



ShipVelocity



Supplier/vendor portals



You don't need to know every system already, but you need to be comfortable learning new software quickly.



What Success Looks Like



The goal of this role is simple:



Our clients should always know what's happening with their projects, our suppliers should always know what we need from them, and our team should never have to wonder whether something was followed up on.



If a packaging supplier says they'll have an update Friday, you're following up Friday.



If a client hasn't approved their artwork, you're following up.



If inventory is supposed to arrive at ShipVelocity, you're confirming that it arrived.



If a project is falling behind schedule, you're identifying the problem and bringing it to the team's attention before it becomes an emergency.



We want someone who takes ownership, not someone who simply completes assigned tasks.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



A brief introduction about yourself and your previous experience.



Any experience you have with project management, client communication, manufacturing, logistics, fulfillment, or supplier coordination.



What project management tools you've used before.



Your current availability and preferred working hours.



Your expected monthly salary.



Start your application with the words "Peakfinity PM" so we know you read the entire job description.



Short Scenario



Please also answer these questions. (Do not use AI for these, we are technologically literate and can tell.):



A client's packaging supplier tells you their bottles are delayed by two weeks, but production is scheduled to begin next week. What would you do?



Tell us about a time you managed multiple projects or clients simultaneously. How did you make sure nothing fell through the cracks?



Three things happen at the same time: a client is asking for an urgent update, a supplier needs an approval today to avoid a delay, and ShipVelocity reports an inventory discrepancy. How would you prioritize them and why?



Write a short message to a client explaining that their project has been delayed by approximately one week because of a packaging supplier issue.



A client sends you a message asking something you don't know the answer to. What do you do before asking your manager?



We're looking for someone who can think through problems and communicate effectively—not simply follow instructions.



If that's you, we're looking forward to speaking with you.

title: Youtube Editor - Long form (Long-Term Opportunity)
description:
This is a long-term position with opportunities for raises and performance bonuses based on quality, reliability, turnaround time, and channel growth.

Please include your expected monthly salary in your application. Applicants seeking significantly higher compensation may still apply, but priority will be given to candidates who fit our current budget.



### Expected Workload

We are looking for an editor who can consistently edit approximately 10-15 long-form videos per month.

The exact workload may vary depending on channel needs.



### About Us

We operate multiple faceless YouTube channels focused on:

* History

* Economics

* Geopolitics

* Business History

* Documentary Storytelling



We are looking for a skilled editor who understands viewer retention and can transform a script and voice-over into an engaging documentary-style video.



### Important

**This position is not for basic video editing. We are looking for editors who can create engaging documentary-style videos by combining storytelling, research, footage sourcing, graphics, music, and pacing.**



### What We Provide

For each video, we will provide:

* Complete script

* Voice-over recording

* Reference YouTube video(s)

* Creative direction and feedback



### Your Responsibilities

* Edit high-retention YouTube videos (20–30 minutes)

* Source relevant stock footage, photos, maps, graphics, animations, and B-roll

* Add text, motion graphics, zooms, transitions, and visual storytelling elements

* Select appropriate background music and sound effects

* Follow the editing style of our reference videos

* Deliver projects on schedule

* Revise videos based on feedback when necessary



### Requirements

* Strong experience editing YouTube videos

* Excellent storytelling and pacing skills

* Ability to keep viewers engaged throughout long-form content

* Proficiency with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar software

* Ability to independently source visuals and assets

* Reliable communication and attention to detail

* Good English comprehension

### Preferred Experience: Comfortable creating/editing longform videos



### IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

To confirm you have read this entire job posting:

1. Include the word **HAPPY** as the second line of your application so we know that you read the requirements and expectations.

2. Answer all application questions below.

Applications that do not follow these instructions will be automatically rejected.



### Application Questions

1. Send links to your 3 best YouTube videos that you personally edited, long form preferred.

2. Which editing software do you use?

3. How many years of YouTube editing experience do you have?

4. Have you edited documentary, history, business, or storytelling channels before?

5. If I provide only a script and voice-over, can you source all footage, images, maps, and graphics yourself? Please explain your process.

6. How many 20–30 minute documentary videos can you realistically edit per month?

7. How many hours per week are available?

8. Do you have reliable internet and if so what is your internet speed?

10. What monthly compensation are you seeking?



### Final Selection Process

To be considered for this position, shortlisted applicants will be required to complete a 60-second sample edit using a script, voice-over recording, and reference video that we provide.

The purpose of this test is to evaluate:

* Storytelling ability

* Editing style

* Visual sourcing skills

* Pacing and viewer retention

* Sound design

* Attention to detail

* Ability to follow instructions



Please do not apply if you are unwilling to complete the sample edit.

Due to the volume of applications, only candidates selected for the next stage will receive the test materials.



### Long-Term Opportunity

We are building multiple YouTube channels and are looking for a reliable editor to grow with us long-term.

Strong performers will receive:

* Higher monthly compensation

* Performance bonuses

* Additional editing projects

* Opportunities to work across multiple channels



If you are passionate about creating engaging documentary-style YouTube content, we would love to hear from you.

Tech Requirements:

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant to Entrepreneur



Real Estate • Construction • Vacation Rentals • Finance



Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | Philippines



I’m looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to work directly with me across several active businesses and investments in the United States.



My businesses include real estate investment and development, construction and excavation, vacation rentals/hospitality, mortgage and finance, and other entrepreneurial projects.



This is not a basic virtual assistant or data-entry position.



I’m looking for someone intelligent, organized, resourceful, tech-savvy, and extremely reliable who can become my right-hand person and help bring organization to a large number of projects, conversations, documents, vendors, deadlines, and ideas.



My days move quickly. Priorities change. New projects come up constantly.



The right person will enjoy that environment.



What You’ll Help Me With



Your responsibilities will include:



* Managing and organizing

* Managing my calendar, appointments, meetings, and reminders

* Creating daily and weekly priority lists

* Following up with contractors, vendors, employees, partners, and service providers

* Tracking projects and making sure tasks don’t fall through the cracks

* Internet research and comparison projects

* Researching products, equipment, properties, vendors, travel, and services

* Organizing Google Drive files and documents

* Creating and maintaining spreadsheets

* Preparing proposals, reports, summaries, and professional documents

* Reviewing invoices, quotes, contracts, and project information

* Helping track construction and real estate projects

* Assisting with vacation-rental operations and administrative tasks

* Coordinating travel and reservations

* Drafting
s and communications on my behalf

* Using AI tools such as ChatGPT to research, organize, summarize, and improve productivity

* Learning my businesses well enough to anticipate what I need



There will also be random projects.



One day you may be comparing construction equipment.



The next day you might research a property, organize bids from contractors, prepare a spreadsheet, help with a vacation rental, research software, coordinate travel, or prepare documents for a meeting.



You need to be comfortable figuring things out.



The Person I’m Looking For



You are probably a good fit if you:



* Are extremely organized

* Have excellent written English

* Communicate clearly and professionally

* Are comfortable speaking English when phone calls are necessary

* Are naturally curious and good at research

* Are very comfortable with technology

* Learn new software quickly

* Understand Google Workspace

* Are comfortable with spreadsheets

* Know how to use ChatGPT and other AI tools effectively

* Can handle confidential business and financial information professionally

* Pay close attention to details

* Can manage multiple projects simultaneously

* Don’t need constant supervision

* Ask questions when necessary but try to find the answer first

* Follow through until something is actually completed

* Are comfortable reminding me when I’m forgetting something

* Can respectfully tell me when something doesn’t make sense



I don’t want someone who simply says, “Done.”



I want someone who thinks:



“What else needs to happen to actually finish this?”



What Will Make You Stand Out



Experience in any of these areas is valuable, but not required:



* Executive assistance

* Real estate

* Construction

* Property management

* Airbnb / vacation rentals

* Mortgage or finance

* Bookkeeping

* Project management

* Social media

* Canva

* Google Sheets / Excel

* CRM systems

* AI tools and automation



You don’t need experience in everything.



Intelligence, organization, initiative, and the ability to learn are more important to me than having the perfect résumé.



Working With Me



I am an entrepreneur managing multiple businesses and projects simultaneously.



I move quickly and tend to have a lot happening at once.



I need someone who can take information coming from different directions and turn it into organization and action.



Over time, I want you to learn how I operate well enough that I don’t have to explain everything.



If you see something that needs to be handled, I want you to handle it or bring it to my attention.



If I mention something important during a conversation, I want it captured.



If someone owes us an answer, I want you following up.



If there’s a better way to organize something, tell me.



The goal is for you to eventually become someone I can say:



“Take care of this.”



…and know it will get handled.



Schedule



This is intended to be a full-time, long-term position.



Because most of my businesses operate on U.S. Pacific Time, there will need to be meaningful overlap with Pacific Time working hours.



I’m willing to structure the exact schedule around the right candidate.



Compensation



Compensation will depend on experience, skills, communication ability, and the level of responsibility you can handle.



I’m willing to pay above-market compensation for an exceptional person who can genuinely make my life easier and grow into a high-level role.



There will be opportunities for increased compensation and responsibility as trust and capabilities grow.



How to Apply



Please do not send me a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with the words:



“I read the entire post.”



Then answer these questions:



1. Why do you think you would be particularly good at this position?

2. Tell me about the busiest executive, entrepreneur, or company you’ve supported.

3. Give me an example of a situation where you solved a problem without being told exactly what to do.

4. What AI tools do you currently use, and how do you use them?

5. Rate yourself from 1–10 in Google Sheets or Excel and explain your rating.

6. What hours are you available to work in Philippine Time?

7. Are you comfortable working hours that overlap with U.S. Pacific Time?

8. What is your desired monthly salary in PHP?

9. What internet connection and backup internet/power options do you have?

10. Send a 60–90 second video introduction telling me why I should hire you.



Finally, include one suggestion for something you think an executive managing several businesses should delegate to an Executive Assistant that I didn’t mention in this job posting.



I’m looking for someone who wants more than another online job.



I’m looking for someone who wants to become an important part of what we’re building.

title: 2D Animator / Rigger Needed (Long-Term, Full-Time)
description:
Illustrator/Animator/Rigger Needed — New Military History YouTube Channel.



JOB OVERVIEW



We're hiring a 2D Illustrator/Animator/Rigger for my channel, a new YouTube channel covering world military history — wars, weapons, commanders, and major conflicts — through cartoon-style storytelling. Our visual and pacing reference is Agent Flappy (137k subscribers)











 — think split-panel comparison thumbnails, bold on-screen text, and cinematic historical scenes told through a consistent cartoon art style. We're not affiliated with Agent Flappy; we're using it as a north star for the quality and tone we're building toward.



This is a ground-floor opportunity for a versatile 2D artist who can design characters and backgrounds, rig them for efficient animation, and animate scenes tightly synced to voiceover — ideally all in one person, since we're just starting out.



You'll work directly with me (the channel owner) — I'll provide scripts, voiceovers, and creative direction, and you'll design the visual world and bring it to life.



COMPENSATION & PERKS

- Typical video length: 8-10 min

- Month 1: $500 — build core character/background asset library + deliver 1 video

- Month 2 onward: $450/month for 2 videos/month, using the asset library you've built

- Retainer scales up as we move to 4 videos/month (growth path, not a fixed commitment yet)

- +5% of AdSense revenue for first 30 days on videos you co-animate

- Paid monthly

- Long-term opportunity with room to level up as the channel grows



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



1) Design & Rig Characters/Scenes

- Design characters, props, and backgrounds in Photoshop or Illustrator, matching our reference style

- Rig characters/props for efficient puppet-style animation

- Build a reusable asset library so future videos are faster to produce



2) Animate Scenes (Weekly/Bi-weekly)

- Import layered PSD files into After Effects

- Animate characters, props, and environments based on:

   - Provided storyboards

   - Voiceover timing

   - Our established animation style

- Apply motion, camera movement, transitions, and light effects as needed



3) Voiceover-Driven Timing & Pacing

- Cut and prep voiceover audio into scene segments

- Sync animation precisely to narration

- Maintain pacing consistent with high-retention YouTube content



4) Project Setup & File Management

- Organize AE projects using a defined folder structure

- Label comps and assets clearly for review and revisions



5) Weekly/Monthly Assembly & Export

- Render scenes for review

- Apply feedback and revisions

- Assemble final sequences (After Effects or Premiere)

- Export final video to channel specifications



6) Collaboration & Reliability

- Work directly with me on a set schedule

- Communicate progress and blockers early

- Hit agreed-upon delivery deadlines



THIS ROLE IS A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

- Love military history, wars, and world affairs

- Enjoy production-focused animation work

- Are comfortable animating quickly to voiceover-driven scripts

- Like working within an established cartoon visual style

- Can reliably deliver on deadline



THIS ROLE IS NOT A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

- Prefer full creative control unrelated to our reference style

- Mostly do corporate explainer videos

- Are looking for a one-off or short-term gig

- Struggle with deadlines



REQUIRED SKILLS



Must-Have:

- Strong proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Photoshop (or Illustrator)

- Ability to design original characters/backgrounds in a cartoon/vector style

- Experience rigging and animating from layered Photoshop files

- Familiarity with rigging tools (Duik, RubberHose, or similar)

- Solid understanding of timing, easing, and motion principles

- Comfortable animating to voiceover-driven scripts

- Organized workflow and clear communication



Nice-to-Have:

- Basic Premiere Pro knowledge

- Experience working on history/military-themed YouTube content

- Interest in military history, wars, weapons, and world conflicts



OUTPUT EXPECTATIONS (IMPORTANT)

- Month 1: core character/background assets + 1 completed video

- Month 2 onward: 2 completed videos per month (8-10 min each), scaling to 4/month as the channel grows

- Consistent quality matching our target style (Agent Flappy as reference)

- Ability to meet deadlines with minimal supervision



HOW TO APPLY

In your application, please include:

1. 2-3 examples of your character/background design work

2. 2-3 examples of your After Effects animation work (cartoon/explainer-style YouTube content preferred)

3. A short note on why you're interested in a ground-floor, long-term YouTube role

4. Your availability (hours/week) and timezone

5. Your rate expectations

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
LEAD THE CREATIVE OPERATION. THEN HELP BUILD WHAT COMES NEXT.

Creative Production is the center of this role at the start. You will manage the editors, own the production system, raise the quality of the work, and make sure strong creative moves from brief to final asset without senior leadership having to manage every detail.



This is not a coordinator role. It is not a virtual-assistant role. We need a Marketing Operations Manager who can operate the day-to-day work and improve the system at the same time.



A NOTE FROM OUR CMO

Before applying, watch this short video from our CMO about the role, its expectations, and what success looks like:


/share/9cd974e7c8a848de8b84a4a992df4e45



Once Creative Production is stable and you have demonstrated the judgment, leadership, and capacity required, the role will expand into Social Media Operations. That second phase will include the team, publishing, community, creator, affiliate, and channel systems around the content.



Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date. The exact timing will depend on demonstrated readiness and business needs.



ABOUT VERITAS

Veritas builds complete Starlink Mini deployment setups—mounts, power, cables, cases, and accessories—for consumers, work teams, and government fleets.



We are a growing US company with a small, high-output marketing team in the Philippines. Several team members have grown with the company over the long term. We want the same for this role.



THE DETAILS

• Full-time independent contractor role with fixed monthly compensation of $2,000–$2,500 USD, based on experience, leadership depth, and overall fit—not an hourly position

• Approximately 45–50 hours per week, with the regular work schedule fully aligned with Pacific Time

• Philippine graveyard shift: roughly 11:00 PM–8:00 AM or 12:00 AM–9:00 AM, depending on U.S. daylight saving time

• Fully remote and long-term

• This must be your only job. No part-time employment, side hustles, ongoing freelance clients, or subcontracting

• Occasional weekend availability when production, launches, or publishing require management coverage

• Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna required; no regular onsite office days, but occasional in-person meetings may be scheduled



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

At full production, the team aims to produce one long-form video and up to 14 supporting creative assets each week. These may include shorts/reels, static graphics, or carousels and are adapted for distribution across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.



PHASE 1: LEAD CREATIVE PRODUCTION

• Manage a two-person video-editing team, including their priorities, workload, deadlines, coverage, development, and performance.

• Turn approved priorities into clear production plans, briefs, scripts, storytelling direction, B-roll needs, and deliverables.

• Own the production pipeline: capacity, assignments, dependencies, revisions, blockers, asset readiness, and delivery visibility.

• Review short-form, long-form, ads, thumbnails, static assets, carousels, platform versions, and other creative output.

• Evaluate the full story—not only whether one shot matches one line. Check hooks, pacing, B-roll, demonstrations, captions, CTAs, factual accuracy, brand alignment, and viewer flow.

• Give editors clear, prioritized, actionable feedback and verify that required revisions were completed correctly.

• Use performance findings to identify stronger hooks, packaging, formats, V2/V3 opportunities, and creative tests.

• Build and improve SOPs, review standards, production trackers, asset repositories, AI-assisted QA, and backup coverage.

• Coordinate minor corrections and urgent production support when needed, without turning the role into a primary editing position.



PHASE 2: ADD SOCIAL MEDIA OPERATIONS

Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date, once Phase 1 is operating reliably and you have demonstrated readiness for the expanded scope. At that point, you will also:

• Manage the current Social Media Moderator and future social media team members.

• Own the publishing calendar, content inventory, platform schedules, launch pushes, and publishing verification across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.

• Ensure each platform receives the correct version, copy, CTA, description, tags, products, related content, links, and native-platform setup.

• Oversee community, marketing inboxes, important comments and messages, channel presentation, and routine reputation handling.

• Manage routine creator-partnership and affiliate operations, including communication, records, deliverables, logistics, and escalation.

• Own routine UTM, Bitly, campaign-link, profile-link, and destination-verification workflows.

• Review social performance and turn findings into decisions, tests, and coordinated creative recommendations.

• Build and maintain the social department’s processes, AI workflows, reporting, and continuity systems.



HOW THE ROLE FITS

You will report to and work closely with senior marketing leadership. In Phase 1, the video editors report to you. In Phase 2, the Social Media Moderator also reports to you.



You will have authority over routine departmental planning, assignments, quality, coaching, corrections, and process improvements within approved standards. Cross-functional, sensitive, contractual, financial, policy, staffing, reputation, and other material decisions remain with senior leadership.



HOW WE USE AI

Our marketing operation uses AI for context, research, briefs, feedback, quality control, documentation, analysis, automation, and institutional memory.



We want someone who uses AI heavily to improve judgment and execution—not someone who accepts raw output. Sources must be checked. Brand and product accuracy must be protected. What the team learns should improve the next workflow.



YOU'RE A STRONG FIT IF YOU

• Have at least eight years of professional work experience.

• Have at least three years managing teams and direct reports.

• Have at least two years of experience inside a creative or marketing function.

• Have meaningful corporate, in-house, agency, or field-based operating experience—not only freelance, VA, or task-based remote experience.

• Have managed a creative-production pipeline and can explain the team size, volume, process, problems, decisions, and results.

• Are exceptionally strong at storytelling and can diagnose why an edit is technically correct but still wrong for the overall story.

• Hands-on video-editing experience is an advantage, but it is not required. You must be able to direct editors, evaluate their work, and clearly explain what needs to change and why.

• Can coach editors, address recurring mistakes, manage underperformance, and maintain accountability without becoming the bottleneck.

• Take action without waiting for step-by-step direction and consistently look for ways to improve quality, speed, visibility, and continuity.

• Use performance evidence to improve creative work—not only report numbers.

• Use AI daily with structured context, validation, human review, reusable systems, and feedback loops.

• Communicate clearly in conversational American English.

• Can sustain a Philippine graveyard schedule and occasional weekend coverage.

• Reside in Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna and be willing to attend occasional in-person meetings.

• Have reliable primary internet, a backup connection, and backup power.

• Want one company to grow with for the long term.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

• Someone who waits for detailed instructions before acting.

• Someone whose experience is limited to task-based VA work, short freelance engagements, or managing multiple clients.

• A strong individual contributor who does not want to manage, coach, and hold people accountable.

• Someone who reviews only technical editing details but cannot evaluate the complete story and business goal.

• Someone who creates more process without improving output, visibility, quality, or results.

• Someone planning to keep another job, freelance clients, or subcontract any part of the work.

• Someone testing a graveyard schedule for the first time without a credible plan to sustain it.



HOW WE WORK

Clear priorities. Direct feedback. Strong ownership. Problems are raised early. Decisions are documented. The goal is not to look busy. The goal is to build work that performs and an operation that improves.



Our brand voice follows the same standard: short words, short sentences, confident but never salesy. Like a friend who knows the gear.



HOW TO APPLY

Use this subject line and at least 20 AP:

[INSERT REQUIRED WORD] - [X] years of professional experience - [X] years managing teams



Include the following:

• Your resume with company names, employment dates, role titles, team sizes, and whether each role was corporate, in-house, agency, freelance, or VA work.

• Have you directly managed a creative-production or video-production team? Answer Yes or No. If yes, state the team size.

• Can you provide examples of videos, campaigns, or creative projects you directly led if you advance to the next stage? Answer Yes or No. Do not send links or detailed explanations at this stage.

• In one short logistics block, confirm that this would be your only job and that you would complete all work personally. Include your city or province, most recent U.S.-hours role and actual schedule, primary and backup internet, backup power, and occasional weekend availability.



Note: Applications missing any requirement will not be considered.

title: Graveyard News Editor
description:
Location: Remote / Work From Home

Schedule: Monday to Friday

Hours: 12:00 AM to 8:00 AM (Philippines Time)



About the Role: 



IBTimes UK is looking for a proactive, traffic-driven Graveyard News Editor to lead our overnight editorial desk.



We're looking for an experienced editor with a strong nose for traffic who can identify stories people will actually click, read, discuss and share. You should understand what works across Reddit, Google Search, Google Discover, MSN and social media, and know that different stories and angles perform on different platforms.



This is not a passive editing role. You will be expected to actively find traffic-generating stories, develop unique angles, react quickly to breaking news, manage the editorial queue, and support both writers and copy editors throughout the shift.



Key Responsibilities:



> Monitor breaking news, Google Trends, Reddit, social media and other sources for emerging and high-potential stories.

> Identify traffic-generating stories and unique angles rather than simply following what competitors are publishing.

> Understand which stories are likely to work across Reddit, MSN, Google Discover, Search and social media, and tailor angles accordingly.

> React aggressively to breaking and developing news, quickly assigning the strongest angles to writers.

> Maintain and continuously adjust the editorial queue based on traffic potential, urgency and developing trends.

> Assign stories to writers based on their strengths, workload and platform potential.

> Support writers with pitches, angles, sourcing, reporting and story development.

> Support copy editors with headlines, difficult edits, prioritisation and editorial decisions.

> Edit and publish articles when required, ensuring accuracy, strong headlines, readability and British house style.

> Identify opportunities for original reporting, expert commentary, Reddit and social reactions, follow-up angles and additional context.

> Ensure the graveyard desk operates efficiently with minimal supervision.

> Reddit Experience

> Strong familiarity with Reddit is essential.



The successful candidate should understand Reddit culture and subreddit communities, know how to identify emerging stories and conversations, and be comfortable strategically promoting suitable IBTimes UK content on Reddit while respecting individual subreddit rules.



Requirements:



> At least three years' experience in digital news, editing or online publishing.

> Previous experience managing or supporting writers and/or copy editors.

> Excellent news judgement and a proven instinct for identifying stories with strong traffic potential.

> Strong understanding of Reddit, Google Search, Google Discover, MSN and social media.

> Ability to develop fresh, compelling angles from breaking, trending and viral stories.

> Strong headline-writing and editing skills.

> Comfortable making fast editorial decisions and working independently.

> Excellent written English and attention to accuracy.

> Familiarity with WordPress or a similar CMS.

> Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to improve editorial workflows while maintaining editorial accuracy.



Success in This Role: 



You'll succeed if you can consistently spot stories with traffic potential, find angles competitors have missed, understand where those stories are most likely to perform, and keep writers and copy editors moving throughout the shift.



You should be equally comfortable jumping on major breaking news, spotting an emerging Reddit conversation, finding a strong Search opportunity, or recognising a story with MSN or Discover potential.



How to Apply



Please send:



> Your CV

> Three editing or published article samples

> A summary of your experience managing editorial teams and using Reddit



Shortlisted candidates will complete an editorial assessment covering news judgement, traffic instincts, Reddit knowledge, headline writing, and story assignment.

title: Real Estate Financial Analyst / Land Appraiser - Land Development & JV Modeling
description:
Real Estate Financial Analyst / Land Appraiser — Land Development & JV Modeling

Fully Remote · Philippines-Based · Full-Time · US Central Time Shift · Reports Directly to the VP of Operations



Why This Role Exists

We are a Central Texas land development and investment firm doing what most of our competitors cannot: turning raw acreage tracts of varying sizes into fully platted, revenue-generating subdivisions. We move fast, we structure JVs directly with landowners, and we deploy real capital on real deals every month.



The problem: our deal flow is outrunning our modeling capacity. Feasibility studies, absorption schedules, and JV waterfalls are stacking up on the VP of Operations' desk — and every day one sits there is a day a deal moves slower. That is where you come in.



What Success Looks Like in 90 Days

• You have taken 3+ live deals from raw acreage to landowner-ready JV pitch — independently.

• The VP of Operations and Founder review your models at the assumption layer, not the formula layer.

• Landowners see your work directly. Your name is on the pro forma at the meeting.



What You Will Actually Do

• Turn raw land into revenue models. Take a raw acreage tract — size depends on the project — decide the lot cut, allocate infrastructure cost, phase the release, and build the per-lot P&L.

• Model absorption like a real one. Monthly ramp schedules by phase — no flat annual averages, no divide-by-12.

• Run Sales Comparable Analyses on land and lots using aged, expired, and active comps to establish real value and defensible days-on-market.

• Build JV waterfalls that hold up under an attorney's audit — preferred returns, pari-passu tiers, IRR hurdles, promote splits, land-contribution structures.

• Produce investor-facing return summaries (IRR, equity multiple, cash-on-cash) for our own JV investment deals — reviewed by ownership and counsel prior to distribution.

• Package landowner-ready decks and spreadsheets that need no revisions before they hit a Zoom call.

• Sit in on live deal calls with US ownership and iterate on assumptions in real time.



Required — Non-Negotiable

• 3–5 years institutional real estate underwriting at Colliers, JLL, Leechiu, Santos Knight Frank, Cushman & Wakefield, CBRE PH, Ayala Land, Megaworld, SMDC, or equivalent.

• Portfolio of at least 2 land or JV models you personally built (anonymized acceptable).

• Demonstrated absorption rate modeling — you must be able to show a live sample ramped monthly schedule during the interview.

• Working knowledge of JV waterfall structures — preferred returns, pari-passu tiers, IRR hurdles, promote splits.

• Advanced Excel — dynamic formulas, sensitivity/data tables, scenario toggles, INDEX/MATCH, XIRR.

• Fluent business English — written and spoken, for direct communication with US ownership and occasional landowner presentations.

• Willing and able to work US Central Time business hours — 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time (approximately 8:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine Time). This is a hard requirement: our deals happen on Texas time, and you sit on the Texas team.

Preferred (Not Required)

• MLS-based comp research experience (Highly Preferred). Comfort pulling and interpreting US MLS data is a big edge.

• Financial modeling certification: REFM (Levels 2–3), REFAI, CFI FMVA, Wall Street Prep REFM, or BIWS Real Estate Modeling. REFM Level 3 With Distinction is a strong plus but not required — reps beat certs.

• Prior exposure to US real estate — CoStar, LandVision, Redfin, MRICS, or US brokerage/PE experience.

Compensation

title: Growth Marketer — Meta Ads, Video & Social (DTC Brand)
description:
Kiddocap is a Canadian safety brand. We make an innovative protective headgear

for toddlers, we sell in Canada only, and we have a lot more products coming.



Here is where we actually are. We spend over CA$250 a day across Meta and

TikTok. Our blended ROAS is around 1. We are losing money on every single

order, and we have been for months.



Our founder is in China on a business trip for the next three months. He is

running the ads himself and he needs help — not someone to hand tasks to,

someone who knows how to make an ad account profitable and will take that on.



You will work Manila hours and speak with him live during your day. No

graveyard shift, no waiting fifteen hours for an answer.



We are small, so the job is broad. You will make ads. You will run our social

accounts. You will dig into the numbers and tell us what they mean. Some weeks

one of those takes over completely. If you want a narrow role with a fixed list

of duties, this is not it.



YOU WILL OWN



Making the ads — short-form video and static, hooks, scripts, the whole thing

Creative strategy: the angles, where they come from, and why they should work

The decision of what to kill, what to scale, and when

Organic social across Instagram, 
 and

Reading the numbers and turning them into decisions, weekly

Cost per order — this is the number you are judged on



WE WANT SOMEONE WHO



Has at least 3 years on Meta ads for e-commerce, direct response

Can explain Meta's delivery and learning mechanics simply

Is genuinely good at hooks and short-form video editing

Can grow a social account, not just post to one

Learns fast and stays current — you know what works on Meta this month, not

what worked two years ago

Uses data to make creative decisions, not to justify them afterwards

Writes excellent English

Owns the problem instead of waiting for instructions



Big advantages

You have taken a small brand and helped it scale

You have worked on a baby, kids, parenting or pediatric brand

You can film your own content

You speak French



We want someone who looks at our account and thinks:



"Here is what is wrong. Here is what I would change first. And here is what I

would need from you to be sure."



WHY THIS IS WORTH YOUR TIME



Most remote marketing jobs are maintenance. Keep the machine running, fill the

calendar, send the report.



This is the opposite. The brand is not profitable yet and one person can change

that. You would not be helping from the outside — you would be part of it, at

the exact point where it turns.



And you are not the one carrying the risk. The company is funded well beyond

what the brand currently earns, so this role does not depend on next month's

sales. Your base is guaranteed from day one. The bonus is upside on top of it.



This is not a two-month contract. We have a much larger product range coming and

we are looking for the person who is still here when this is a serious brand.



We want you to become necessary.



COMPENSATION



₱62,000/month base (about US$1,000), paid twice monthly via Wise



Monthly performance bonus based on account ROAS:

1.5 or above ₱6,200 (US$100)

1.8 or above ₱12,400 (US$200)

2.1 or above ₱18,500 (US$300)

2.5 or above ₱24,700 (US$400)

3 or above ₱31,000 (US$500)



13th month pay · HMO health coverage after 90 days

Salary review at 6 months — we expect this to go up



TO APPLY



Start your message with the word BLUE, or we will not read it.



Please send:



1. A short video introduction, under 3 minutes. Walk us through one piece of

your work — what you were trying to do and whether it worked.



2. 3-5 links to Meta ads you personally worked on: the brand, your actual role,

and what happened to the numbers.



3. One social account you grew, and where it started.



4. The challenge.



Here is where we are. Canadian safety brand, protective headgear for

toddlers, Canada only. Over CA$250 a day across Meta and TikTok. Blended

ROAS around 1 — we lose money on every order. Product sells for CA$69.99,

average order CA$85.



On Meta we run one campaign, one ad set, broad targeting. Last month we

launched 15 ads into it at once. One ad absorbed 79% of the spend and

produced 18 of the 21 sales. Eleven of the others received under CA$60 each.



Tell us what you would do.



We are not going to tell you what to look at, or where to find it. Working

that out is part of the test.



The more specific your answer is to us, the more seriously we take it. If you

tell us something about our brand that we did not tell you here, that is

exactly what we are looking for. Answers that could apply to any e-commerce

brand will not be read twice.



300 words maximum.



NO AGENCIES. We are hiring directly.

Applications without a video will not be reviewed.

title: Full-Time WFH Client Success Manager — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Social Media and Content Creation VA
description:
The Role

We are specifically looking for an experienced Social Media & Content Creation Virtual Assistant with a minimum of 3 years’ hands-on experience managing social media, creating content, editing video and supporting the digital presence of a business.



For the right person there is genuine room to grow: additional days and hours over time based on performance, capability and where the business heads. We want someone who wants to be a long-term part of the team, not someone passing through.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

You take raw footage, photos and notes from our building sites and turn them into finished content. Most of what you receive will be unedited — phone footage straight off site, unsorted photos and short briefs. You build the finished piece from that. This is a production role: behind the camera and the screen, not in front of it.



1. Social media content creation  —  your main focus

• Edit short-form vertical video for Instagram Reels and
 — project walkthroughs, before-and-afters, build progress, behind-the-scenes

• Build edits from raw footage: cut, pace, sequence, sync music, level audio, colour correct

• Design branded graphics, carousels, infographics and story templates

• Edit and enhance project photography for social and marketing use

• Write captions in our brand voice and schedule against our content calendar

• Check what we have already posted so ideas do not repeat

• Propose new content ideas rather than waiting to be briefed



2.  Marketing and ad campaigns 

• Build and run paid ad campaigns on Meta 
 and Instagram) — campaign setup, audiences, budgets and scheduling in Ads Manager

• Create the ad creative — video ads, static ads, carousels and multiple copy variations to test against each other

• Plan and run wider marketing campaigns across social,
 and SMS

• Build supporting campaign assets — landing page content, lead capture forms, promotional graphics

• Monitor ad performance, test variations, and report on cost per lead and what is converting



3.  GoHighLevel and website maintenance  

• Build automation, workflows, forms, and landing pages in GHL

• Basic
 and SMS campaigns

• Upload and format blog posts in WordPress

• Update website images, text and page content

• Basic SEO implementation and tracking



What You Must Have

• 3+ years’ experience in social media content creation and video editing

• Strong short-form vertical video editing skills, demonstrated with a portfolio

• Hands-on ability in real editing software — CapCut Pro or other similar software

• Strong graphic design skills — Canva at minimum; Photoshop or Illustrator a plus

• Genuine editing and design skill. AI is fine as a tool, but we are not looking for AI-generated content or preset templates.

• Speed — you produce quality work efficiently without being chased

• Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to write in a brand voice that is not your own

• Reliable and self-managing



Nice To Have

• Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager — running or supporting paid
 and Instagram campaigns

• Some exposure to GoHighLevel — even a little. Preferred, not essential.

• Experience with Australian construction, building, trades or property brands — a bonus, not a prerequisite

• Motion graphics, WordPress or basic SEO familiarity



How To Apply

• Send your resume and your portfolio. Put the word "Big Brain" at the top of your application so we know you have read this.

• Your portfolio should include work samples of reels and graphics you personally created. Links (Google Drive, Dropbox, Vimeo, YouTube or personal site) are all fine.



Our Hiring Process

1. Initial interview

2. Skill Assessment - One-day paid trial on real Locspec footage — paid work, not a free test

3. Final Interview

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
About Us

We're Premium Invention, a fast growing e-commerce company selling premium solar-powered security cameras to property owners across North America. We're expanding our product line, and we need the person who makes everything we ship look premium. Every page, every image, every pixel.



About This Role

You own how Premium Invention looks everywhere a customer sees us. Every landing page, every ad, every
, every product image. Premium is our positioning, and you are the person who makes premium visible.

This is not a support role where someone hands you a brief and you make it pretty. You will have real input on how the brand looks and feels. We hire designers for their taste and their opinions, not just their execution.



What You Will Own

- Product landing pages and campaign pages, designed separately for desktop and mobile. 80% of our buyers are on mobile, so mobile is not an afterthought.

- AI-generated product imagery. Lifestyle scenes, hero shots, feature visuals using tools like Midjourney or Flux. You should be fast and comfortable working with AI as part of your daily workflow.

- Ad creative for Meta and Google.
 designs for Klaviyo campaigns and flows.

- The design system that keeps everything consistent. Spacing, components, typography rules, color usage.

- Occasional product support: packaging layouts, instruction manuals, product branding placement. This is maybe 10% of the role, not the core.



What We Are Looking For

- 4+ years designing for e-commerce or DTC brands. Your portfolio must include live website URLs with shipped pages. Concept work and Dribbble mockups alone will not qualify.

- Premium visual taste. Your work should feel like it belongs next to Apple or a well-funded Kickstarter hardware launch. Clean, minimal, confident.

- Obsessive attention to detail. You are the person who notices 4 pixels off before anyone else does.

- Fast with AI, finished by hand. You use AI image tools for speed and volume, but your judgment and polish make the final output. You can show us the AI draft vs. your finished version and explain every change you made.

- Expert-level Figma. Clean auto-layout, organized components, files that another designer could pick up without a walkthrough.

- You design for conversion, not applause. You think about what makes someone click, scroll further, or buy. You bring ideas to the table, not just execute what is asked.

- Comfortable with time tracking through Hubstaff. Full-time hours with at least 3 to 4 hours of daily overlap with North American mornings for real-time collaboration.



What We Offer

- $2,200 to $3,000/month depending on experience.

- Full-time, long-term position.

- Short feedback loops and real ownership. No design-by-committee, no three rounds of approvals. You ship work that customers see within days, not months.



Who should NOT apply

- If your portfolio is only concept work, school projects, or unreleased designs. We need to see live pages that real customers have used.

- If you have never designed for products sold at a premium price point. Our products compete against cheaper alternatives, and the design needs to match the positioning. Premium product design requires a completely different instinct.

- If you only manage other designers or agencies but do not personally design. This is a hands-on role.

- If your experience is only print, branding identities, or logo design with no web or e-commerce work.

- If you cannot commit to full-time hours with time tracking. This is not a side project.

title: Data Support Analyst
description:
We are looking for a dependable and customer-oriented individual to join our SDS Admin team in a dual-focus role. Roughly half of your time will be spent on SDS management operations — maintaining our Safety Data Sheet database and supporting manufacturer outreach. The other half will focus on customer support and growth for our ISDSS platform, handling user queries through live chat,email, and phone, and contributing to platform content and improvement.



This role is ideal for someone who is organised and detail-oriented, communicates well in English, and is comfortable switching between data tasks and direct user interactions. As ISDSS continues to grow, there is real scope for this role to evolve with it.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- ISDSS Customer Support

• Serve as the first point of contact for ISDSS (sdsinventory.com) users via live chat, email, and phone

• Respond to user queries promptly, accurately, and in a professional manner

• Troubleshoot and resolve common issues, escalating where appropriate

• Monitor the support inbox to ensure no queries go unanswered

• Create and maintain knowledge base articles, FAQs, and support guides

• Contribute to regular team reporting as needed



QUALIFICATIONS

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

• Customer service mindset with a professional and approachable manner

• Comfortable working independently and as part of a remote team

title: SEO & Website Growth Specialist
description:
A. Role Summary



Position: SEO & Website Growth Specialist

Employment: Full-time, remote

Reports to: Owner



Harris Plumbing is looking for a hands-on digital marketer to own the growth and performance of our website and organic search presence.

This is not primarily a blog-writing position and is not a traditional “SEO assistant” role. The successful candidate will combine strong SEO judgment, Webflow execution skills, local-search expertise, analytics, call attribution, and content management.



The primary objective is to increase qualified calls, booked jobs, and revenue generated by organic search and our website across Harris Plumbing's service areas in Ontario.



Our major service categories include residential plumbing repairs, leaks, clogged drains, flooding issues, dripping fixtures, well-pump/no-water calls, water heaters, water treatment, smart water shutoffs, water pressure problems, and related residential plumbing services.



B. What You Will Own



B1. SEO Strategy & Keyword Prioritization



You will maintain a structured keyword opportunity model covering:

- Search volume

- Commercial intent

- Search difficulty

- Geographic relevance

- Current Harris ranking

- Competitor rankings

- Existing landing page

- Estimated business value

- Search Console impressions and clicks

- Recommended action and priority



You will determine which opportunities should be addressed by improving existing pages, creating new pages, consolidating pages, building internal links, or earning additional authority.



We care more about ranking for commercially valuable searches than producing a predetermined quantity of content.



B2. Webflow Website Management



You should be comfortable independently building and managing a Webflow website. 



Responsibilities include:

-Creating service and educational pages

-Editing existing pages

-Managing CMS collections

-Updating copy and images

-Creating internal links

-Managing titles and meta descriptions

-Updating headings and page structure

-Adding and validating schema markup

-Managing redirects

-Optimizing image sizes and alt text

-Maintaining URL structure

-Performing basic mobile-layout adjustments

-Creating landing pages from approved templates and components



You are not expected to be a senior software developer. More complex custom development can be outsourced when necessary.



B3. On-Page & Technical SEO



You should understand and be able to diagnose:

-Search intent

-Keyword cannibalization

-Indexation

-Crawlability

-Canonicals

-XML sitemaps

-301 redirects

-Internal-link architecture

-Structured data

-Duplicate/thin content

-Page titles and headings

-Core Web Vitals

-Mobile usability

-Page speed

-Image optimization

-Broken links

-Site architecture



You should be comfortable using tools such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Semrush or Ahrefs, and PageSpeed Insights.



B4. Local SEO



Harris competes market-by-market, so local SEO experience is particularly valuable.



You should understand:

-Google Business Profile

-Local Pack/Maps rankings

-Geographic search intent

-Service-area businesses

-Location landing pages

-Reviews and reputation signals

-Local citations

-NAP consistency

-Local backlinks

-Competitor Maps analysis

-Local search-grid/rank-tracking tools



You must understand the difference between building valuable location content and creating thin or repetitive doorway-style pages.



B5. Call Tracking & Marketing Attribution



You will help ensure that Harris can determine which marketing sources generate actual customers.



You should understand:

-Dynamic number insertion

-Tracking phone numbers

-CallRail or similar systems

-UTMs

-GA4

-Google Tag Manager

-Google Search Console

-Conversion events

-Source/medium attribution

-Form attribution

-Landing-page attribution

-CRM attribution



You will work toward connecting:

Search → landing page → call/form → booking → completed job → revenue



You should also understand how tracking numbers can be implemented without creating unnecessary local-SEO/NAP problems.



B6. LSA Lead Analysis



You will take ownership of reviewing and classifying Google Local Services Ads leads.



The objective is not simply to “score calls.”

You will categorize leads such as:



Booked / legitimate but unbooked / price objection / wrong service / outside service area / spam / missed opportunity / unavailable appointment / cancellation / existing customer



You will submit appropriate lead-quality feedback to Google where applicable and analyze the underlying economics of LSA.



Reporting should eventually include:

Cost per lead → qualified-lead rate → booking rate → cancellation rate → completed-job rate → revenue per lead → gross profit per lead



B7. Content Development



You will work collaboratively with Harris's owner, plumbers, managers, and other subject-matter experts.



The preferred process is:

Identify opportunity → research search intent → interview subject-matter expert → create content brief → use AI where useful → human edit/fact-check → build page → optimize → publish → measure → improve



AI should accelerate good research and subject-matter expertise rather than generate large quantities of generic content.



B8. Off-Page SEO



You should understand sustainable authority building, including:



-Competitor backlink analysis

-Supplier/manufacturer links

-Industry organizations

-Legitimate business directories

-Local organizations

-Community relationships

-Local media

-Partnerships

-Digital PR opportunities

-Link-worthy resources



We are not interested in bulk low-quality backlinks, link farms, automated link schemes, or buying hundreds of links.



B9. Reporting & Continuous Improvement



Reporting should focus on business outcomes rather than vanity metrics. Important KPIs will include:



- Qualified non-brand organic clicks: Measures acquisition beyond people already searching Harris

- Organic calls and forms - Measures actual lead generation

- Booked jobs from organic traffic - Measures lead quality and conversion

- Revenue / GP from organic customers - Ultimate economic result

- Priority keywords in Top 3 / Top 10 - Measures search visibility

- Share of search by service/category - Measures competitive position

- Website visitor-to-lead conversion - Measures site effectiveness

- Search impressions and CTR - Identifies ranking and messaging opportunities

- Local/Maps visibility - Measures local availability

- Publishing/optimization backlog completed - Measures execution velocity



C. Required Experience
