title: UGC Brand Partnership Manager (Salary + Commission)
description:
UGC Brand Manager (Part-time, Remote)



We're looking for a part-time UGC Brand Manager for a fast-growing UGC creator. Your job is to find us brand deals and help us go viral. That's it.



Remote role. We're based in Bangkok and prefer someone in Thailand or the Philippines for timezone overlap.



WHAT WE MAKE



Every video follows the same shape: a reaction hook in the first 3 seconds filmed by our creator, a screen demo of the app in the middle, and a benefit or call to action at the end. Here's an example account: 



Every brand we work with is an app or software. We don't work with physical products. We'll train you on the UGC side, so you don't need to know it on day one.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Platforms. Log in to Sideshift and the other platforms we're on. Review new campaigns, apply to the 10 best, and manage the inbox, since brands often reach out to us first. Check rates, read the brief, watch the content references, and look the brand up on Instagram and TikTok to see whether other creators are already making content for them.



Instagram outbound. Send 10-15 pitch messages to brands using our template. Send 10 DMs to UGC creators asking what deals they're working with. Follow up with anyone who hasn't replied after 3 days.




. Work our UGC communities. Read the deals channels, apply to anything that fits, post asking for referrals where it's allowed, and DM active creators who look like they're having success to find out what's paying well right now.



Tracker. Fill it out at the end of every day. What you applied to, who you pitched, who replied, and where each deal stands.



Referrals convert best, direct brand DMs second, platform applications third. On a short day you keep the referral and DM work.



JUDGING DEALS



The core of this job is d
 which opportunities are worth our time.



Our ideals are a CPM of $1.50 or above and a base of around $700 a month or more, but those trade against each other. A $2 CPM with a $500 base is fine.



What doesn't flex: other creators need to already be going viral with that brand, the content has to be straightforward to replicate, and the idea has to be easy to understand. A calorie tracker or an AI image generator works. Anything abstract doesn't.



Skip campaigns with no reference videos, campaigns that are 100% scripted, and anything over 45 videos.



WHEN A BRAND REPLIES



Take initiative and move the conversation forward. Get the brief, the reference videos, the pay terms, the deliverable count, and the deadline. Look the app up on social and see what's already working for them. Then make a call on whether we should pursue it and bring it to me with your reasoning. I confirm terms and contracts, not you.



ONCE WE'RE IN A CAMPAIGN



Our creator never talks to brands and never reads briefs. Everything reaches her through you, in plain simple language: the video styles to copy with links, the most viral videos for that brand that we can realistically remake, the app link, the pay rate, and any hard requirements like tags or hashtags.



From there you're managing the production side, and this is where a lot of the value of the role sits. One of your key responsibilities is helping us go viral. You're effectively our social media manager for that account: telling us which hooks to use, which formats to copy, what's trending in that brand's space, and how to get the most views out of every video.



Some apps need screen demo footage of the product in use. When they do, you record it. Case by case, not every brand.



COMPENSATION



Base retainer paid monthly, plus 10% commission on every deal you close. Deals typically run $500 to $2,000+.



Most of our deals pay on a CPM, so you're directly incentivised on views. A video that hits 1 million views at a $2 CPM pays $2,000, and your commission on that is $200. At a $3 CPM it's $300. The more we blow up, the more you make.



Part-time contract role, around 10 hours a week to start. You set your own hours, but you need to get results. KPIs are measured: messages sent, applications submitted, replies, and deals signed.



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU



Have experience in marketing, social media, influencer work, or brand partnerships. Can find a brand's marketing contact without being handed a list. Communicate clearly in written English, since you'll be dealing with US brand managers. Can make a judgment call and defend it. Can hold a daily routine without supervision.



Hands-on UGC or brand partnership experience is a strong plus, either as a creator yourself or from the brand, agency, or talent side. Not a hard requirement if the rest is there.



YOU'RE NOT A FIT IF YOU



Plan to work the inbox reactively instead of proactively hunting for deals. Need close supervision to stay on a daily routine. Want a role with no measured output.



TO APPLY



Send me one or two examples of UGC or brand partnership deals you've sourced or managed, including the brand name, creator size, and outcome. If you don't have those, tell me about the closest thing you've done.



Then tell me how you'd find me 3 new deals in your first week, plus your availability and rate expectation.



THE BIGGER PICTURE



Alongside this account, I run a UGC mentorship program for people landing their first brand deals. As this role grows, I want you sourcing opportunities I can pass to students in the program.



If you want to eventually manage a pipeline of brand relationships across a network of creators rather than a single account, this is the role that gets you there.

title: Audio Quality Control Engineer
description:
About Jess Escalona Media



Jess Escalona Media helps coaches and consultants grow their reach and visibility through podcasting, without the tech overwhelm. We provide calm, systems-led, done-for-you production so our clients can focus on showing up and sharing their voice. Our founder brings 10+ years of experience as an audiobook producer for Big 5 publishers, and that same standard of professionalism runs through everything we deliver.



The Role



We're looking for an Audio Engineer & Quality Control Specialist to own mastering and final quality control on every episode we produce. Right now, every episode passes through our founder's ears before it goes to a client. This role exists to build the trust and standard that lets that step move to you, so we can grow past our current capacity without quality slipping.



We need someone with a trained ear and real technical judgment, someone who can be trusted to be the last line of defense before a client hears their episode.



What You'll Do

Master incoming audio using iZotope RX, FabFilter, and/or Waves plugins to a consistent, professional standard

Deliver finished work as a Reaper session file so your process and decisions are visible and reviewable

Act as a second, independent set of ears on every episode after the editor's first technical pass

Catch and clean up anything missed in the initial edit (artifacts, pacing issues, inconsistent levels, awkward cuts, breath control, etc.)

Apply a documented quality standard consistently, and flag anything outside it rather than guessing

Communicate proactively if something needs a decision or is at risk of missing a deadline

What Success Looks Like

Clients consistently receive polished, professional audio without Jess needing to personally review it

Deliverables are on time, every time

Over time, Jess trusts your judgment as the final check on quality, not just an extra pass



You Might Be a Fit If You

Have hands-on experience mastering audio with iZotope RX, FabFilter, and/or Waves

Are comfortable working in Reaper

Have a trained ear for quality, pacing, and consistency, and notice things other people miss

Take ownership of your work rather than waiting to be told what's wrong

Communicate clearly and proactively

Want to grow with a small business and take on more independent ownership over time



Nice to Have, Not Required

Prior experience with podcast or audiobook production specifically

Experience mentoring or QC-ing another editor's work

Compensation & Structure



$8/hour, 10-20 hours per week -- hoping to grow more.

The right person should be able to take an assignment such as:



> “Build a new city page for this client, optimize it for local search and AI search, publish it in WordPress, add internal links and schema, and make sure it supports the client’s Local SEO strategy.”

### Primary Responsibilities



* Write high-quality SEO blog articles, service pages, location pages, and landing pages.

* Research cities, services, competitors, keywords, and local search intent before writing.

* Create genuinely unique city/location content rather than simply changing city names in a template.

* Build and publish pages in WordPress.

* Handle on-page SEO including titles, headings, metadata, internal links, images, alt text, URL structure, and content optimization.

* Work with citations, NAP consistency, directories, local links, reviews/reputation signals, and other local authority opportunities.

* Analyze local competitors and identify what is helping them rank.

* Help develop and execute SEO/AEO/GEO strategies.

* Optimize content for Google Search, Google Maps, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI-driven discovery platforms.

* Create and implement appropriate schema/structured data when needed.

* Monitor Search Console, rankings, indexing, and other SEO opportunities.

* Improve existing website pages instead of only producing new content.

* Help with ongoing monthly client deliverables and recurring SEO tasks.

* Assist with Rank Local’s own websites and content when client work is lighter.



### WordPress Skills

You should be able to:



* Create and edit pages and posts.

* Duplicate existing layouts.

* Format content properly.

* Add internal and external links.

* Add/edit images and alt text.

* Edit metadata.

* Work with common page builders or Gutenberg.

* Make basic layout/content corrections.

* Identify when an issue requires a developer instead of attempting something outside your ability.



### SEO Skills I Care About Most



Strong experience in:



* Local SEO

* On-page SEO

* Off-page SEO

* SEO copywriting

* Keyword research

* Content strategy

* Service-area and location-page optimization

title: Bookkeeper for Canadian E-Commerce Brand
description:
ABOUT US

We're a Canadian DTC tea brand and sell through our Shopify store. We ship to the US and Canada from warehouses in both countries.



We're a startup and currently mid-six figures in annual revenue and growing. We transact in both USD and CAD, with most sales in USD.



We want to transition from an automated bookkeeping tool (Finaloop) to QuickBooks Online and looking for a detail-oriented bookkeeper to own our books going forward. We're looking for someone who wants to build a long-term relationship and grow with us - not a short-term gig.



THE SCOPE

Phase One: Catchup & Cleanup (First 1-2 Months)

You'll start by reconciling and cleaning up our books for the current year so far. This includes setting up a clean chart of accounts in QuickBooks Online, importing historical transactions, and getting everything reconciled and audit-ready.



Phase Two: Ongoing Monthly Management

Once the books are clean, this transitions into a long-term monthly role covering everything below.



RESPONSIBILITIES

Transaction Management

- Categorize and reconcile all bank and credit card transactions in QuickBooks Online

- Reconcile Shopify payouts against actual orders and refunds

- Reconcile multi-currency accounts (USD + CAD) - you must ensure the bank balance in QBO matches the statement exactly, including handling exchange rate differences

- Match and track Meta 
/Instagram) ad spend invoices against bank withdrawals

- Process and track expenses - supplier invoices, 3PL fees, freight, customs charges, software subscriptions

- Ensure every transaction has proper supporting documentation



Canadian Tax Compliance

- Prepare and file quarterly GST/HST returns

- Match receipts and invoices to maximize input tax credits (ITCs)

- Track provincial sales tax obligations

- Track US sales tax exposure (we use Shopify's auto-tax, but you'll verify)



Monthly Reporting

- Prepare monthly Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements

- Flag anomalies, unusual charges, or budget variances

- Provide financial clarity to founders - not just numbers, but what they mean



Inventory & COGS

- Track landed costs (product cost + ocean freight + customs duties + warehousing)

- Maintain accurate COGS records aligned with inventory movements

- Reconcile inventory valuation quarterly



Expense Tracking

- Track recurring software costs

- Track supplier invoices, 3PL fees, freight, and customs charges

- Ensure all expenses are properly categorized and documented



Year-End

- Prepare working papers and schedules for our CPA/accountant

- Support annual corporate tax return preparation

- Prepare any required slips



REQUIRED TECH STACK (Do Not Apply Without This Experience)



- QuickBooks Online - Expert level. This is non-negotiable.

- Multi-Currency Banking  - We operate in USD and CAD. You must have experience reconciling multi-currency accounts and handling exchange rates so the bank balance in QBO matches the statement to the penny.

- Shopify - Experience reconciling Shopify payouts to QBO.

- Google Sheets - Comfortable with ad-hoc reports and collaboration.



REQUIREMENTS

Must Have:

- 3+ years of bookkeeping experience using QuickBooks Online

- Experience with Canadian GST/HST filing and input tax credits

- Experience with e-commerce businesses (Shopify strongly preferred)

- Experience reconciling multi-currency accounts (USD + CAD)

- Strong attention to detail - we have zero tolerance for sloppy entries

- Fluent in English with strong written communication



Nice to Have:

- Experience with DTC or subscription-based businesses

- Experience with inventory accounting and landed cost tracking

- Previous experience transitioning a company from another system onto QuickBooks



HOURS & COMPENSATION

- Part-time to start - most likely 10-20 hours a month as we're still a small business, but expect it to grow as we scale

- Schedule: Flexible, but must have overlap with Pacific Time for communication

- Rate: $5–$10 USD/hour depending on experience

- Long-term: We want someone who grows with us. This is not a one-off project.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS

- A key financial support role for a growing e-commerce brand

- Someone who brings order, accuracy, and visibility to our finances



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



- Not basic data entry

- Not a once-a-month check-in

- Not suitable for someone who needs constant direction



HOW TO APPLY

We ignore generic cover letters. To show us you've read this posting and have the attention to detail we need, please follow these steps:



**Step 1:** Start your message with the word TEA.



**Step 2:** In your message, answer the following questions:



**Question A:** We use multi-currency banking (USD and CAD). How do you handle the exchange rate difference in QBO when reconciling a multi-currency account to ensure the bank balance matches the statement?



**Question B:** We receive Shopify payouts approximately 3 times per week. Each payout bundles sales, refunds, fees, and adjustments. How would you reconcile these in QBO? Walk us through your approach.



**Question C:** What is your experience with Canadian GST/HST input tax credits? Give us a specific example of how you've maximized ITCs for a previous client.



**Question D:** We track our true landed COGS (product cost + inbound freight + duties + 3PL) in a separate inventory system that produces a monthly COGS figure. In QuickBooks Online, walk us through exactly how you'd record COGS each month so our P&L and balance sheet stay accurate. Be specific about which accounts you'd use and what entries you'd make.



**Step 3:** Include the following:

- A short intro about yourself and your bookkeeping experience

- Your experience with e-commerce / Shopify businesses specifically

- Your expected monthly rate in PHP

- Your available hours and timezone

- Your QuickBooks Online proficiency self-rating (1-10)



Applications that do not answer the screening questions will not be considered. We value accuracy, initiative, and clear communication.

title: Financial Operations Manager / Controller (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~15 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (typically 15-20 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location:  Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: August



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. 



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:30 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:30 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Monday only), and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 15–20 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

•  Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

title: Social Media DM Setter
description:
We are looking for a results-driven Instagram Appointment Setter / DM Sales Specialist to join our team.



Your primary responsibility will be to turn Instagram conversations into qualified, booked sales calls. You will handle both inbound and outbound conversations, build genuine relationships with potential clients, qualify leads, overcome basic objections, follow up consistently, and book qualified prospects into our calendar.



This is not a general virtual assistant role. We are looking for someone who understands sales conversations and knows how to move a prospect naturally from first contact to a booked call.



Responsibilities

Manage inbound Instagram DMs from potential clients

Conduct outbound DM outreach to engage qualified prospects

Start natural, personalised conversations that do not feel spammy or robotic

Build rapport and identify prospects' goals, challenges, and level of interest

Qualify leads based on our criteria

Handle common objections and keep conversations moving forward

Follow up consistently with warm and interested leads

Book qualified prospects directly into the sales calendar

Confirm and remind prospects to help improve show-up rates

Keep CRM and lead information accurate and up to date

Track daily KPIs, including outreach, conversations, qualified leads, booked calls, and show rates

Provide regular performance updates and communicate clearly with the team



Requirements

Previous experience as an Instagram DM Setter, Appointment Setter, or DM Sales Representative

Experience handling both inbound and outbound lead conversations

Strong written English and excellent communication skills

Ability to build rapport and hold natural conversations

Confidence qualifying leads and guiding conversations toward a booked call

Strong follow-up discipline and attention to detail

Highly organized and able to manage multiple conversations simultaneously

Comfortable working toward clear performance targets and KPIs

Reliable, coachable, proactive, and self-motivated



Preferred Experience

Experience with any of the following is a plus:



High-ticket offers

Online coaching, fitness, or service-based businesses

GoHighLevel

Instagram and Meta Business Suite

CRM management

Sales qualification frameworks

Google Sheets and KPI reporting



Performance Expectations

You will be measured on results, including:



Number of meaningful conversations started

Number of qualified leads generated

Number of calls booked

Booking conversion rate

Prospect show-up rate

Quality of booked leads



We are looking for someone who is focused on quality conversations and measurable results, not simply sending a high volume of copy-and-paste messages.



How to Apply

The industry or type of business you worked with.

The number of calls you booked in your best week or month.

Your average show-up rate, if available.

Examples of relevant KPIs or results you achieved.

A brief explanation of how you would turn a cold Instagram follower into a booked sales call.

Any anonymized screenshots or examples of previous results or DM conversations.

Your availability and time zone.



We are looking for a long-term team member who is reliable, coachable, competitive, and motivated by performance.



If you believe you can confidently turn Instagram conversations into qualified booked calls, we would love to hear from you.

title: Head of Systems & Delivery
description:
Step up into the seat that runs an Australian agency's entire delivery operation.



We're an established Australian growth agency in a highly regulated health sector. We build brands, websites, CRM automations and lead nurture journeys for clients where compliance isn't optional — and we own internal brands of our own: a 20,000-member online community, an education platform and a product brand. Founder-led, senior specialist team, heavily AI-integrated (Claude is part of daily work here, and it will be part of yours).



Our delivery lead is moving on, and we're not backfilling a coordinator — we're upgrading the seat. This is the number-two operational role in the business: you run delivery, the founder runs strategy and sales.



What you'll own:



The team's output. A senior designer, developer, video editor and social media manager deliver the work — you make sure it ships. You'll run everything in ClickUp: priorities, deadlines, dependencies, briefs, QA against our launch standards. When a designer's blocked or a developer's output misses the standard, you're the one who sorts it — directly, not by escalating it upward.



The client experience. Onboarding from signed proposal to kickoff. Approvals chased, requests triaged and routed, timelines defended. Clients deal with you for delivery; they deal with the founder for strategy.



The founder. He is the bottleneck on approvals and decisions — that's the honest reality of a founder-led agency. You'll send him a short daily list of exactly what he owes the business, with deadlines, and follow up when he sits on it. If managing your own boss sounds uncomfortable, stop reading. If it sounds like the missing piece of every job you've had — keep going.



The systems. This is not a delegation-only role, and people who've stopped building shouldn't apply. Roughly half your week is hands-on: GoHighLevel pipelines, workflows and nurture sequences, landing pages in GHL or WordPress/Elementor,
 campaigns and newsletters for clients and our internal brands, GA4/GTM/Search Console setup on every site we ship, and SOPs written as you stabilise each process.



You're ready for this if:



You've done 3+ years agency-side across delivery, marketing systems, automation or
 — and you've been the person others relied on to keep the machine running, whatever your title said

You're hands-on deep in GoHighLevel, or deep in HubSpot/Keap/ActiveCampaign and certain you'd master GHL inside 60 days (we test it)

You've coordinated or led other doers — briefed them, QA'd them, chased them — even informally

You've built and sent real
 campaigns and can talk about what the numbers made you change

Domains, DNS and hosting don't scare you; you fix, not just describe

You use AI daily as a working tool, not a novelty

You're the person who notices the form with no success message before the client does



Bonus: Shopify, WordPress beyond landing pages,
 deliverability (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), SOP libraries you've written, regulated-industry experience.



The deal: Independent contractor, 30–40 hrs/week, AUD $12–25/hr depending on experience, plus 13th month pay. 90-day trial with written goals at day 30, 60 and 90 — you'll always know exactly what success looks like. Minimum 6 hours/day AEST overlap. Long-term seat, built to grow as the agency does — this role expands, it doesn't cap.



How to apply —
 
 with:



A note before you start: we use AI every day and expect you to. But these questions are about your actual work — if an AI could answer them without you, you've answered them wrong. Generic answers are the fastest way to not hear back. Specifics, names, numbers and screenshots are the fastest way to an interview.



Your CV.

One real system you built — with proof. A link or Loom of the system, plus one screenshot from inside the build (workflow, automation, campaign — blur client names if needed), plus 3–5 sentences: who it was for, what it replaced, and one thing that broke or underperformed after launch and what you did about it. If nothing ever broke, we won't believe the rest.



Written answers — from your history, not a textbook:



Describe the worst deliverability or DNS problem you've personally fixed. What was actually wrong, how did you find it, and how long did it take? (Name the tools you used. "I would check SPF/DKIM" is a textbook answer — we want the war story.)



Tell us about a specific time you had to get work out of someone who didn't report to you — who were they (role, not name), what were they sitting on, what did you actually say or do, and did it work?



What's the most recent thing you built or fixed that nobody asked you to? When was it, what triggered it, and what happened after? "Recent" matters — last month beats three years ago.



A 2–3 minute Loom (camera on for the intro, then screen share): Start with 30 seconds on you — who you are, where you're based, and what you're into outside of work. Then walk us through the system from question 2 — show us the actual build on screen. Finish by answering this out loud without a script: a client's
s suddenly start landing in spam — talk us through your first thirty minutes. We want to hear how you think, not a rehearsed script; you may have notes but shouldn't be reading.



Subject line: Head of Systems — [your name]



Applications missing the screenshot or the Loom won't be reviewed. That's the first test.

title: Social Media Video Editor & Content Creative for Fitness/Coaching Brand
description:
Social Media Video Editor & Content Creative for Fitness/Coaching Brand



NOTE: Do not apply through here - read ad, then apply below by clicking google form link



I’m looking for a creative and reliable social media editor to join me on an ongoing part-time basis.



The majority of the work will be supporting my fitness coaching business, Peak & Base Training and Nutrition, creating content around fat loss, strength training, muscle building, nutrition and helping everyday people get into better shape.



There may also occasionally be content relating to business coaching, Anytime Fitness and other projects I’m involved with.



What you'll mainly be helping with



Your primary responsibility will be editing and repurposing social media content, including:



- Instagram Reels and other short-form videos

- Talking-head content

- Gym footage and B-roll

- Voiceover-style videos

- Podcast/coaching-call clips from time to time

- Carousels

- Story graphics

- Before-and-after transformations

- Thumbnails

- Static promotional graphics

- Occasional Meta ad or landing-page creatives

- Repurposing older content into our current branding



Most short-form videos will be approximately 45–90 seconds



The editing style is generally personality-driven rather than overly cinematic.



Think:



- Strong captions

- Punch-in zooms

- B-roll

- Stock footage where appropriate

- Sound effects

- Lists, charts and graphic overlays

- Pattern interrupts

- Clean pacing

- Good storytelling



A lot of the content uses humour, personality and sometimes cheeky or shock-style jokes, so strong English comprehension is important.



I'm looking for more than someone who just presses buttons



I'll retain the final say over the direction, hooks and messaging, but I'd love to work with someone who is confident enough to contribute ideas.



Ideally, you'll regularly bring me 3–5 content ideas, trends, hooks or formats each week that suit:



- Our audience

- Our current marketing objectives

- What's currently working on social media

- Any offer or campaign we're currently promoting



If you've got experience helping with hooks, scripts, shot ideas or content strategy, that's a big advantage.



I want this to feel collaborative.



If you see a better way of presenting something, I'd rather you tell me than simply wait for instructions.



Experience



Ideally, you have at least 1 year of regular social-media editing experience, although portfolio quality and actual ability matter far more to me than how many years you've been editing.



Experience working with:



- Fitness

- Coaches

- Personal brands

- Educational content



is preferred but isn't essential.



A great editor with excellent creative instincts will absolutely be considered regardless of niche.



Software



I'm not concerned about which specific editing software you prefer.



You may use CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, After Effects or another tool.



I also have access to CapCut Pro and Canva Pro, which can potentially be provided if required.



We'll predominantly work through tools such as:



- Google Drive

- CapCut Cloud

- Canva

- WhatsApp



Hours



Initially, I expect this role to be approximately 5–10 hours per week.



For the right person, there is definitely room for this to grow toward 15–20+ hours per week as the business and content output grow.



Some crossover with Australian Eastern Standard Time is preferred. Ideally, you can overlap for at least 1–2 hours on most working days when required.



Most work can still be completed asynchronously.



What matters to me



I'm looking for someone who is:



- Creative

- Reliable

- Organised

- Confident

- Comfortable giving and receiving feedback

- Good at communicating

- Interested in social-media trends

- Able to understand humour and conversational English

- Capable of working independently

- Willing to bring ideas instead of constantly waiting for instructions



The goal is to build an ongoing relationship with someone who can become an important part of the content process as the role grows.



How to apply



Please do NOT apply by sending a standard application message through OnlineJobs.ph.



To be considered, complete the Google Form linked below:







The form contains questions about your experience, portfolio, availability, rate and the type of support you can provide.



Applications will be reviewed through the form so that all candidates can be assessed fairly and consistently.



Thanks — I'm looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Sales & Meta Ads Manager – High-Ticket AI SaaS
description:

We are looking for an exceptional sales professional who can take ownership of our Meta advertising and sales pipeline—from generating and qualifying leads through to follow-up, proposals and closing.



Our director will conduct the main face-to-face strategy meetings. You will be responsible for everything around those meetings and for ensuring qualified opportunities progress through the pipeline.



The Role



This is a combined performance marketing and high-ticket sales role.



You will manage our Meta Ads campaigns, respond to incoming leads, qualify prospects, confirm appointments, prepare our director for strategy meetings, follow up opportunities and help close new XoomAI clients.



You must be confident speaking with Australian business owners by phone,
, SMS and video. Exceptional spoken and written English is essential.



This is not an entry-level position, a general VA role or a simple appointment-setting job. We need someone commercially minded who understands how to move a prospect from initial interest through to a signed agreement.



Key Responsibilities



Meta Advertising

Manage and 
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

Monitor campaign performance, lead quality, cost per lead and booked-meeting rates.

Test new audiences, offers, messaging and creative variations.

Identify underperforming campaigns and make data-driven improvements.

Coordinate the production of new advertising copy and creative concepts.

Ensure leads are tracked correctly from advertisement through to sale.

Report on advertising spend, pipeline value and revenue generated.

Focus on qualified sales opportunities—not vanity metrics or cheap, low-quality leads.



Lead Qualification and Appointment Management

Contact new leads quickly by phone, SMS and
.

Qualify prospects based on business fit, needs, authority, urgency and budget.

Clearly explain the value of XoomAI and create interest in a strategy meeting.

Book qualified prospects into the director’s calendar.

Confirm appointments and reduce no-shows through professional follow-up.

Reschedule missed appointments and continue nurturing suitable prospects.

Maintain accurate notes and next actions within the CRM.



Sales Pipeline Management

Take ownership of every opportunity from initial enquiry through to close.

Research each prospect and prepare useful briefing notes before meetings.

Attend internal sales handovers and understand the recommended solution.

Prepare and send proposals, agreements and supporting information.

Conduct post-meeting follow-up by phone,
 and SMS.

Handle common questions and sales objections confidently.

Create urgency without using aggressive or dishonest sales tactics.

Keep opportunities moving and ensure no qualified lead is forgotten.

Re-engage older leads and nurture prospects who are not ready to purchase immediately.

Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline stages and expected close dates.

Close suitable opportunities and secure signed agreements and initial payments.



What We Are Looking For

You should have:



Excellent spoken English with clear, confident and professional pronunciation.

Outstanding written English.

Proven experience selling high-ticket services, SaaS, technology, marketing or business solutions.

A strong record of closing—not just booking appointments.

Experience speaking directly with business owners and senior decision-makers.

Experience managing Meta Ads campaigns and improving lead-generation performance.

Strong discovery, qualification, objection-handling and follow-up skills.

Confidence making outbound calls and following up leads repeatedly.

Experience using a CRM and maintaining a disciplined sales pipeline.

Strong commercial judgement and the ability to understand how a business operates.

Excellent organisation, personal accountability and attention to detail.

The ability to work independently and communicate proactively with management.

Reliable internet, a professional work environment and high-quality audio equipment.



Experience selling AI, SaaS, managed IT, automation, digital marketing or consulting services will be highly regarded.



Who Will Succeed in This Role?

You will be a strong fit if you:



Are naturally persuasive, confident and commercially aware.

Know how to build trust with business owners.

Ask intelligent questions and listen carefully before recommending a solution.

Understand that consistent follow-up is essential in high-ticket sales.

Can balance persistence with professionalism.

Care about lead quality and revenue—not simply the number of appointments booked.

Take ownership of results and do not need to be constantly supervised.

Enjoy working toward measurable targets.

Want your earning potential to be directly connected to your performance.



Who Should Not Apply?

Please do not apply if:



You have only worked as a general virtual assistant.

Your experience is limited to scripted cold calling or basic appointment setting.

You are uncomfortable speaking with prospects by phone.

You rely entirely on scripts and cannot think commercially during a conversation.

You have never managed Meta advertising campaigns.

You have no experience progressing and closing higher-value sales.

You need constant direction to complete routine responsibilities.

You are looking for an hourly role without performance expectations.



Performance Measures

Your performance will be measured against:



Meta Ads cost per qualified lead.

Number of qualified meetings booked.

Appointment attendance rate.

Speed to first contact.

Lead-to-meeting conversion rate.

Proposal-to-close conversion rate.

Average sales cycle.

Monthly recurring revenue generated.

Accuracy and cleanliness of the CRM pipeline.

Overall return on advertising spend.



Compensation

This position includes:



A reliable monthly retainer.

Commission on successfully closed sales.

Uncapped earning potential.

Performance incentives for consistently achieving targets.

Long-term growth opportunities as XoomAI expands.



The final compensation structure will depend on your experience, demonstrated results and availability.



Working Hours

You must have strong availability during Australian business hours.



Some flexibility may be available for campaign management and administrative work, but lead calls, appointment confirmation and sales follow-up must occur during suitable Australian hours.



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:



A brief introduction explaining why you are suited to this role.

Details of the high-ticket products or services you have sold.

Your average deal value and your personal closing results.

Examples of Meta Ads campaigns you have personally managed.

Your experience working with business owners or senior decision-makers.

A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining how you would follow up a prospect who attended a meeting but had not yet made a decision. Can use : 



A short written response to the scenario below.



Scenario:

A business owner submitted an enquiry after seeing one of our Meta advertisements. You called twice but received no answer. Write the SMS and
 you would send to encourage them to book a conversation.



Please begin your application with the words “AI REVENUE” so we know you have read the complete job description.



Generic or AI-generated applications that do not include the requested sales results, advertising experience and voice recording will not be considered.

title: GoHighLevel Expert
description:
About Us

Higher View Tax Services is not your average financial company. We’re a fast-growing, forward-thinking team that prioritizes excellence, connection, and creativity in everything we do. As we scale toward national goals, we’re looking for someone who can amplify our presence across key social media platforms and bring our brand voice to life with precision, strategy, and style.



Job Overview

We are seeking an expert-level GoHighLevel (GHL) Builder & Automation Specialist to help design, build, and optimize a robust, scalable CRM system inside GoHighLevel. You must be able to use the marketers tool.



This role is not for beginners, funnel-only builders, or snapshot-only users. We are building a structured, long-term CRM environment and require someone with a deep understanding of GoHighLevel’s advanced features, automation logic, and CRM architecture.



In this role, you will work closely with the Product Owner and CRM Architect to translate system requirements into clean, reliable, and scalable builds within GoHighLevel. Candidates must have hands-on experience using GoHighLevel’s marketer tools to customize and configure the platform.



Key Responsibilities



GoHighLevel CRM Development



Build, customize, and manage CRM systems within GoHighLevel.



Create and maintain pipelines, opportunity stages, custom fields, tags, and structured contact data.



Configure user roles, permissions, and access levels as needed.



Maintain clean organization, naming conventions, and consistency across the system.



Automation & Workflow Development

5. Build advanced workflows using triggers, conditions, and actions.

6. Implement tag-based and pipeline-based automation logic.

7. Configure time delays, branching paths, safeguards, and fail-safes.

8. Prevent automation conflicts, loops, duplicate actions, and system errors.

9. Optimize workflows for performance, reliability, and scalability.



Integrations & System Setup

10. Configure and manage integrations including calendars, forms, Stripe, and related system components.

11. Build and manage integrations using Zapier and/or webhooks when applicable.

12. Troubleshoot and resolve automation and integration issues efficiently.



Testing, Quality Control & Documentation

13. Test workflows end-to-end prior to launch.

14. Identify edge cases, logic gaps, and system risks.

15. Resolve issues thoroughly and promptly.

16. Document workflows, automations, and system logic clearly so future tea
mbers can easily understand and maintain the system.





Required Skills & Experience



Must-Have Qualifications:



Minimum of 3+ years of hands-on experience using GoHighLevel at an advanced level.



Strong understanding of workflows, automation logic, triggers, conditions, and actions.



Proven experience working with pipelines, tags, custom fields, and CRM data structures.



Demonstrated experience building full CRM systems, not just funnels or landing pages.



Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify and fix broken or conflicting automations.



High attention to detail with strong system-thinking and problem-solving abilities.





Nice-to-Have (Not Required):



Agency-level GoHighLevel experience.



Zapier or webhook integration experience.



Experience integrating GoHighLevel with WordPress or other external platforms.



Experience working in financial services, tax, or other highly structured industries.





This Role Is Not a Fit For:



Beginners or individuals still learning GoHighLevel.



Funnel-only or snapshot-only builders.



VAs who require step-by-step instructions for every task.



Candidates without real-world automation and CRM build experience.



Work Details



Remote position.

Must have working overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

This is a long-term opportunity for the right candidate.

Paid hourly (rate based on experience).

title: GHL/Marketing VA
description:
I am looking for a versatile, fast-moving Marketing Assistant to join our team. This is a hands-on, generalist role designed for someone who loves variety and knows how to leverage AI tools to multiply their output. One day you might be building a landing page with an AI site builder, the next you are editing a short-form video, and the day after that you are tuning a Meta Ads campaign. You do not need to be a specialist in any one area—you need strong fundamentals across all of them, deep curiosity for AI tools, and the ability to ship polished, on-brand work fast.

Web & Funnels: Build clean, functional landing pages using AI site builders without needing custom code

Paid Ads: Set up, target, budget, and monitor Meta Ads campaigns while reading basic performance metrics.

CRM & Automation: Connect Meta Ads to GoHighLevel (GHL), integrating lead forms and routing leads into GHL pipelines and automations.

Visual Design: Create modern graphic design assets and collateral aligned with brand guidelines.

Video Production: Edit highly engaging short-form video content for social media channels.

Independent Execution: Take a brief, experiment with new AI workflows, and run with projects autonomously.



Required Skills & Experience

- Proven comfort using tools like Lovable, Claude, or similar landing page builders

-Hands-on experience with campaign setup, targeting, and budget management.

- Experience setting up lead forms and routing automation within GHL.

- Proficiency in Canva, Figma, Adobe Suite, CapCut, Premiere, or similar tools.

- A fast learner who genuinely enjoys testing new AI tools daily.

- Strict consistency with brand guidelines and a sharp eye for quality control.

- Experience supporting Australian or international clients.

- Experience running campaigns on other platforms like Google Ads or TikTok Ads.

- Deeper experience optimizing GoHighLevel or similar CRM systems.

- Basic copywriting skills for writing ad creative and high-converting landing page copy.





To be considered, please provide:

1. Your updated resume and a link to your portfolio

2. A list of the specific software, CRM platforms, and AI tools you use daily.

3. Your years of experience supporting Australian or international businesses.
